```{r setup, eval=T, include=F, message=F, warning=F}
# custom function to mutate a subset of rows (a few chunks use it)
mutate_cond <- function(.data, condition, ..., envir = parent.frame()) {
  condition <- eval(substitute(condition), .data, envir)
  .data[condition, ] <- .data[condition, ] %>% mutate(...)
  .data
}
```

# Human maps

Here we use several mutation maps, pyrho recombination maps as well as
a the positions of functionally constrained elements in the human genome
(build 38 and SFS-based DFEs) to predict B-values and pi along autosomes

When we propose models (DAGs) based on simulated pi,
we can treat the maps as "true" and avoid modeling error in their estimation.

## Preparing the data 

Equilibrium demography, functional model of constrained elements (split exons)

```{r eq-func-split, eval=F, include=F, message=F, warning=F}

human_maps_10kb_uniform <- data.frame()
human_maps_10kb_roulette <- data.frame()
human_maps_10kb_carlson <- data.frame()
human_maps_10kb_gnomad <- data.frame()

pb <- txtProgressBar(min=0, max=22, style=3)
for(c in 1:22) {
  setTxtProgressBar(pb, c)
  roulette_10kb <- fread(paste("~/Data/bgs_lmr/human_data/current_models/",
                          "equilibrium/functional_split_exons/roulette/",
                          "B_tbl_YRI_chr", c, "_10kb.csv.gz", sep=""))
  
  human_maps_10kb_roulette <- rbind.data.frame(human_maps_10kb_roulette, 
                                               roulette_10kb)
  
  carlson_10kb <- fread(paste("~/Data/bgs_lmr/human_data/current_models/",
                          "equilibrium/functional_split_exons/carlson/",
                          "B_tbl_YRI_chr", c, "_10kb.csv.gz", sep=""))

  human_maps_10kb_carlson <- rbind.data.frame(human_maps_10kb_carlson, 
                                              carlson_10kb)
  
  gnomad_10kb <- fread(paste("~/Data/bgs_lmr/human_data/current_models/",
                          "equilibrium/functional_split_exons/gnomad/",
                          "B_tbl_YRI_chr", c, "_10kb.csv.gz", sep=""))
  
  human_maps_10kb_gnomad <- rbind.data.frame(human_maps_10kb_gnomad, 
                                             gnomad_10kb)
  
  uniform_10kb <- fread(paste("~/Data/bgs_lmr/human_data/current_models/",
                          "equilibrium/functional_split_exons/uniform/",
                          "B_tbl_YRI_chr", c, "_10kb.csv.gz", sep=""))

  human_maps_10kb_uniform <- rbind.data.frame(human_maps_10kb_uniform, 
                                              uniform_10kb)
}
close(pb)
  
# introducing mutation noise in expected pi
S <- 100 # diploid sample size

# we simulate pi neu., del. and tot. independently, 
# but this is fine for our purposes 

## roulette
pi_sim <- numeric(length=nrow(human_maps_10kb_roulette))
pi_sim_neu <- numeric(length=nrow(human_maps_10kb_roulette))
pi_sim_del <- numeric(length=nrow(human_maps_10kb_roulette))
for(i in 1:S) { 
    pi_sim <- pi_sim + rbinom(size=1e+4, 
                              n=nrow(human_maps_10kb_roulette),
                              prob=human_maps_10kb_roulette$exp_pi) / 1e+4
    
    pi_sim_neu <- pi_sim_neu + rbinom(size=1e+4, 
                               n=nrow(human_maps_10kb_roulette),
                               prob=human_maps_10kb_roulette$exp_neu_pi) / 1e+4
    
    pi_sim_del <- pi_sim_del + rbinom(size=1e+4, 
                               n=nrow(human_maps_10kb_roulette),
                               prob=human_maps_10kb_roulette$exp_del_pi) / 1e+4
}
     
human_maps_10kb_roulette$pi_sim_tot <- pi_sim / S
human_maps_10kb_roulette$pi_sim_neu <- pi_sim_neu / S
human_maps_10kb_roulette$pi_sim_del <- pi_sim_del / S

human_maps_10kb_roulette$coverage <- human_maps_10kb_roulette$num_sites / 1e+4
human_maps_10kb_roulette$prop_del_sites <- human_maps_10kb_roulette$del_sites / 
  human_maps_10kb_roulette$num_sites

# summarizing in terms of AC and CV (not for uniform mut maps as they are flat)
## 10 kb
human_summaries_10kb_roulette <- human_maps_10kb_roulette %>% group_by(chrom) %>%
                            mutate(cv_mut=sd(avg_mut)/mean(avg_mut)) %>%
                            mutate(cv_rec=sd(avg_rec)/mean(avg_rec)) %>%
                            mutate(ac_mut=as.numeric(unlist(acf(avg_mut,
                                                                lag=1, 
                                                                pl=F))[2])) %>%
                            mutate(ac_rec=as.numeric(unlist(acf(avg_rec,
                                                                lag=1, 
                                                                pl=F))[2])) %>%
                            distinct(chrom, .keep_all=T)
```

```{r eq-func-merged, eval=F, include=F, message=F, warning=F}
human_maps_10kb_uniform <- data.frame()

for(c in 1:22) {
  setTxtProgressBar(pb, c)
  roulette_10kb <- fread(paste("~/Data/bgs_lmr/human_data/current_models/",
                          "equilibrium/functional_merged_exons/roulette/",

close(pb)
  
# introducing mutation noise in expected pi
S <- 100 # diploid sample size

# we simulate pi neu., del. and tot. independently, 
# but this is fine for our purposes 

## roulette
pi_sim <- numeric(length=nrow(human_maps_10kb_roulette))
pi_sim_neu <- numeric(length=nrow(human_maps_10kb_roulette))
pi_sim_del <- numeric(length=nrow(human_maps_10kb_roulette))
for(i in 1:S) { 
    pi_sim <- pi_sim + rbinom(size=1e+4, 
                              n=nrow(human_maps_10kb_roulette),
                              prob=human_maps_10kb_roulette$exp_pi) / 1e+4
    
    pi_sim_neu <- pi_sim_neu + rbinom(size=1e+4, 
                               n=nrow(human_maps_10kb_roulette),
                               prob=human_maps_10kb_roulette$exp_neu_pi) / 1e+4
    
    pi_sim_del <- pi_sim_del + rbinom(size=1e+4, 
                               n=nrow(human_maps_10kb_roulette),
                               prob=human_maps_10kb_roulette$exp_del_pi) / 1e+4
}
     
human_maps_10kb_roulette$pi_sim_tot <- pi_sim / S
human_maps_10kb_roulette$pi_sim_neu <- pi_sim_neu / S
human_maps_10kb_roulette$pi_sim_del <- pi_sim_del / S

human_maps_10kb_roulette$coverage <- human_maps_10kb_roulette$num_sites / 1e+4
human_maps_10kb_roulette$prop_del_sites <- human_maps_10kb_roulette$del_sites / 
  human_maps_10kb_roulette$num_sites
```

```{r eq-phastcons, eval=F, include=F, message=F, warning=F}
# introducing mutation noise in expected pi
S <- 100 # diploid sample size

# we simulate pi neu., del. and tot. independently, 
# but this is fine for our purposes 

## roulette
pi_sim <- numeric(length=nrow(human_maps_10kb_roulette))
pi_sim_neu <- numeric(length=nrow(human_maps_10kb_roulette))
pi_sim_del <- numeric(length=nrow(human_maps_10kb_roulette))
for(i in 1:S) { 
    pi_sim <- pi_sim + rbinom(size=1e+4, 
                              n=nrow(human_maps_10kb_roulette),
                              prob=human_maps_10kb_roulette$exp_pi) / 1e+4
    
    pi_sim_neu <- pi_sim_neu + rbinom(size=1e+4, 
                               n=nrow(human_maps_10kb_roulette),
                               prob=human_maps_10kb_roulette$exp_neu_pi) / 1e+4
    
    pi_sim_del <- pi_sim_del + rbinom(size=1e+4, 
                               n=nrow(human_maps_10kb_roulette),
                               prob=human_maps_10kb_roulette$exp_del_pi) / 1e+4
}
     
human_maps_10kb_roulette$pi_sim_tot <- pi_sim / S
human_maps_10kb_roulette$pi_sim_neu <- pi_sim_neu / S
human_maps_10kb_roulette$pi_sim_del <- pi_sim_del / S

human_maps_10kb_roulette$coverage <- human_maps_10kb_roulette$num_sites / 1e+4
human_maps_10kb_roulette$prop_del_sites <- human_maps_10kb_roulette$del_sites / 
  human_maps_10kb_roulette$num_sites
```

```{r 4e-func-split, eval=F, include=F, message=F, warning=F}
human_maps_10kb_uniform <- data.frame()

close(pb)
  
# introducing mutation noise in expected pi
S <- 100 # diploid sample size

# we simulate pi neu., del. and tot. independently, 
# but this is fine for our purposes 

## roulette
pi_sim <- numeric(length=nrow(human_maps_10kb_roulette))
pi_sim_neu <- numeric(length=nrow(human_maps_10kb_roulette))
pi_sim_del <- numeric(length=nrow(human_maps_10kb_roulette))
for(i in 1:S) { 
    pi_sim <- pi_sim + rbinom(size=1e+4, 
                              n=nrow(human_maps_10kb_roulette),
                              prob=human_maps_10kb_roulette$exp_pi) / 1e+4
    
    pi_sim_neu <- pi_sim_neu + rbinom(size=1e+4, 
                               n=nrow(human_maps_10kb_roulette),
                               prob=human_maps_10kb_roulette$exp_neu_pi) / 1e+4
    
    pi_sim_del <- pi_sim_del + rbinom(size=1e+4, 
                               n=nrow(human_maps_10kb_roulette),
                               prob=human_maps_10kb_roulette$exp_del_pi) / 1e+4
}
     
human_maps_10kb_roulette$pi_sim_tot <- pi_sim / S
human_maps_10kb_roulette$pi_sim_neu <- pi_sim_neu / S
human_maps_10kb_roulette$pi_sim_del <- pi_sim_del / S

human_maps_10kb_roulette$coverage <- human_maps_10kb_roulette$num_sites / 1e+4
human_maps_10kb_roulette$prop_del_sites <- human_maps_10kb_roulette$del_sites / 
  human_maps_10kb_roulette$num_sites
```

```{r 4e-func-merged, eval=F, include=F, message=F, warning=F}

human_maps_10kb_uniform <- data.frame()
human_maps_10kb_roulette <- data.frame()
human_maps_10kb_carlson <- data.frame()
human_maps_10kb_gnomad <- data.frame()

pb <- txtProgressBar(min=0, max=22, style=3)
for(c in 1:22) {
  setTxtProgressBar(pb, c)
  roulette_10kb <- fread(paste("~/Data/bgs_lmr/human_data/current_models/",
                          "4_epoch/functional_merged_exons/roulette/",
                          "B_tbl_YRI_chr", c, "_10kb.csv.gz", sep=""))
  
  human_maps_10kb_roulette <- rbind.data.frame(human_maps_10kb_roulette, 
                                               roulette_10kb)
  
  carlson_10kb <- fread(paste("~/Data/bgs_lmr/human_data/current_models/",
                          "4_epoch/functional_merged_exons/carlson/",
                          "B_tbl_YRI_chr", c, "_10kb.csv.gz", sep=""))

  human_maps_10kb_carlson <- rbind.data.frame(human_maps_10kb_carlson, 
                                              carlson_10kb)
  
  gnomad_10kb <- fread(paste("~/Data/bgs_lmr/human_data/current_models/",
                          "4_epoch/functional_merged_exons/gnomad/",
                          "B_tbl_YRI_chr", c, "_10kb.csv.gz", sep=""))
  
  human_maps_10kb_gnomad <- rbind.data.frame(human_maps_10kb_gnomad, 
                                             gnomad_10kb)
  
  uniform_10kb <- fread(paste("~/Data/bgs_lmr/human_data/current_models/",
                          "4_epoch/functional_merged_exons/uniform/",
                          "B_tbl_YRI_chr", c, "_10kb.csv.gz", sep=""))

  human_maps_10kb_uniform <- rbind.data.frame(human_maps_10kb_uniform, 
                                              uniform_10kb)
}
close(pb)
  
# introducing mutation noise in expected pi
S <- 100 # diploid sample size

# we simulate pi neu., del. and tot. independently, 
# but this is fine for our purposes 

## roulette
pi_sim <- numeric(length=nrow(human_maps_10kb_roulette))
pi_sim_neu <- numeric(length=nrow(human_maps_10kb_roulette))
pi_sim_del <- numeric(length=nrow(human_maps_10kb_roulette))
for(i in 1:S) { 
    pi_sim <- pi_sim + rbinom(size=1e+4, 
                              n=nrow(human_maps_10kb_roulette),
                              prob=human_maps_10kb_roulette$exp_pi) / 1e+4
    
    pi_sim_neu <- pi_sim_neu + rbinom(size=1e+4, 
                               n=nrow(human_maps_10kb_roulette),
                               prob=human_maps_10kb_roulette$exp_neu_pi) / 1e+4
    
    pi_sim_del <- pi_sim_del + rbinom(size=1e+4, 
                               n=nrow(human_maps_10kb_roulette),
                               prob=human_maps_10kb_roulette$exp_del_pi) / 1e+4
}
     
human_maps_10kb_roulette$pi_sim_tot <- pi_sim / S
human_maps_10kb_roulette$pi_sim_neu <- pi_sim_neu / S
human_maps_10kb_roulette$pi_sim_del <- pi_sim_del / S

human_maps_10kb_roulette$coverage <- human_maps_10kb_roulette$num_sites / 1e+4
human_maps_10kb_roulette$prop_del_sites <- human_maps_10kb_roulette$del_sites / 
  human_maps_10kb_roulette$num_sites

## carlson
pi_sim <- numeric(length=nrow(human_maps_10kb_carlson))
pi_sim_neu <- numeric(length=nrow(human_maps_10kb_carlson))
pi_sim_del <- numeric(length=nrow(human_maps_10kb_carlson))
for(i in 1:S) { 
    pi_sim <- pi_sim + rbinom(size=1e+4, 
                              n=nrow(human_maps_10kb_carlson),
                              prob=human_maps_10kb_carlson$exp_pi) / 1e+4
    
    pi_sim_neu <- pi_sim_neu + rbinom(size=1e+4, 
                               n=nrow(human_maps_10kb_carlson),
                               prob=human_maps_10kb_carlson$exp_neu_pi) / 1e+4
    
    pi_sim_del <- pi_sim_del + rbinom(size=1e+4, 
                               n=nrow(human_maps_10kb_carlson),
                               prob=human_maps_10kb_carlson$exp_del_pi) / 1e+4
}
     
human_maps_10kb_carlson$pi_sim_tot <- pi_sim / S
human_maps_10kb_carlson$pi_sim_neu <- pi_sim_neu / S
human_maps_10kb_carlson$pi_sim_del <- pi_sim_del / S

pi_sim_del <- numeric(length=nrow(human_maps_10kb_gnomad))

                              n=nrow(human_maps_10kb_gnomad),
                              prob=human_maps_10kb_gnomad$exp_pi) / 1e+4

                               n=nrow(human_maps_10kb_gnomad),
                               prob=human_maps_10kb_gnomad$exp_del_pi) / 1e+4
}
```

```{r 4e-func-phastcons, eval=F, include=F, message=F, warning=F}
human_maps_10kb_uniform <- data.frame()
human_maps_10kb_roulette <- data.frame()
human_maps_10kb_carlson <- data.frame()
human_maps_10kb_gnomad <- data.frame()

pb <- txtProgressBar(min=0, max=22, style=3)
for(c in 1:22) {
  setTxtProgressBar(pb, c)
  roulette_10kb <- fread(paste("~/Data/bgs_lmr/human_data/current_models/",
                          "4_epoch/phastcons/roulette/",
                          "B_tbl_YRI_chr", c, "_10kb.csv.gz", sep=""))
  
  human_maps_10kb_roulette <- rbind.data.frame(human_maps_10kb_roulette, 
                                               roulette_10kb)
  
  carlson_10kb <- fread(paste("~/Data/bgs_lmr/human_data/current_models/",
                          "4_epoch/phastcons/carlson/",
                          "B_tbl_YRI_chr", c, "_10kb.csv.gz", sep=""))

  human_maps_10kb_carlson <- rbind.data.frame(human_maps_10kb_carlson, 
                                              carlson_10kb)
  
  gnomad_10kb <- fread(paste("~/Data/bgs_lmr/human_data/current_models/",
                          "4_epoch/phastcons/gnomad/",
                          "B_tbl_YRI_chr", c, "_10kb.csv.gz", sep=""))
  
  human_maps_10kb_gnomad <- rbind.data.frame(human_maps_10kb_gnomad, 
                                             gnomad_10kb)
  
  uniform_10kb <- fread(paste("~/Data/bgs_lmr/human_data/current_models/",
                          "4_epoch/phastcons/uniform/",
                          "B_tbl_YRI_chr", c, "_10kb.csv.gz", sep=""))

  human_maps_10kb_uniform <- rbind.data.frame(human_maps_10kb_uniform, 
                                              uniform_10kb)
}
close(pb)
  
# introducing mutation noise in expected pi
S <- 100 # diploid sample size

# we simulate pi neu., del. and tot. independently, 
# but this is fine for our purposes 

## roulette
pi_sim <- numeric(length=nrow(human_maps_10kb_roulette))
pi_sim_neu <- numeric(length=nrow(human_maps_10kb_roulette))
pi_sim_del <- numeric(length=nrow(human_maps_10kb_roulette))
for(i in 1:S) { 
    pi_sim <- pi_sim + rbinom(size=1e+4, 
                              n=nrow(human_maps_10kb_roulette),
                              prob=human_maps_10kb_roulette$exp_pi) / 1e+4
    
    pi_sim_neu <- pi_sim_neu + rbinom(size=1e+4, 
                               n=nrow(human_maps_10kb_roulette),
                               prob=human_maps_10kb_roulette$exp_neu_pi) / 1e+4
    
    pi_sim_del <- pi_sim_del + rbinom(size=1e+4, 
                               n=nrow(human_maps_10kb_roulette),
                               prob=human_maps_10kb_roulette$exp_del_pi) / 1e+4
}
     
human_maps_10kb_roulette$pi_sim_tot <- pi_sim / S
human_maps_10kb_roulette$pi_sim_neu <- pi_sim_neu / S
human_maps_10kb_roulette$pi_sim_del <- pi_sim_del / S

human_maps_10kb_roulette$coverage <- human_maps_10kb_roulette$num_sites / 1e+4
human_maps_10kb_roulette$prop_del_sites <- human_maps_10kb_roulette$del_sites / 
  human_maps_10kb_roulette$num_sites

# summarizing in terms of AC and CV (not for uniform mut maps as they are flat)
## 10 kb
human_summaries_10kb_roulette <- human_maps_10kb_roulette %>% group_by(chrom) %>%
                            mutate(cv_mut=sd(avg_mut)/mean(avg_mut)) %>%
                            mutate(cv_rec=sd(avg_rec)/mean(avg_rec)) %>%
                            mutate(ac_mut=as.numeric(unlist(acf(avg_mut,
                                                                lag=1, 
                                                                pl=F))[2])) %>%
                            mutate(ac_rec=as.numeric(unlist(acf(avg_rec,
                                                                lag=1, 
                                                                pl=F))[2])) %>%
                            distinct(chrom, .keep_all=T)

human_summaries_10kb_carlson <- human_maps_10kb_carlson %>% group_by(chrom) %>%
                            mutate(cv_mut=sd(avg_mut)/mean(avg_mut)) %>%
                            mutate(cv_rec=sd(avg_rec)/mean(avg_rec)) %>%
                            mutate(ac_mut=as.numeric(unlist(acf(avg_mut,
                                                                lag=1, 
                                                                pl=F))[2])) %>%
                            mutate(ac_rec=as.numeric(unlist(acf(avg_rec,
                                                                lag=1, 
                                                                pl=F))[2])) %>%
                            distinct(chrom, .keep_all=T)

human_summaries_10kb_gnomad <- human_maps_10kb_gnomad %>% group_by(chrom) %>%
                            mutate(cv_mut=sd(avg_mut)/mean(avg_mut)) %>%
                            mutate(cv_rec=sd(avg_rec)/mean(avg_rec)) %>%
                            mutate(ac_mut=as.numeric(unlist(acf(avg_mut,
                                                                lag=1, 
                                                                pl=F))[2])) %>%
                            mutate(ac_rec=as.numeric(unlist(acf(avg_rec,
                                                                lag=1, 
                                                                pl=F))[2])) %>%
                            distinct(chrom, .keep_all=T)

human_summaries_10kb_roulette$scale <- 1e+4
human_summaries_10kb_carlson$scale <- 1e+4
human_summaries_10kb_gnomad$scale <- 1e+4
```

## Plotting landscapes

```{r plot-models, eval=F, include=F, message=F, warning=F}

# NOTE plotting with somewhat permissive coverage thresholds
# skip 10kb, too cluttered
maps_100kb <- fread("real_data_maps/maps_100kb_models.csv.gz")
maps_1Mb <- fread("real_data_maps/maps_1Mb_models.csv.gz")

min_points_for_line <- 2 # for breaking lines in maps

pb <- txtProgressBar(min=0, max=22, style=3)
for(c in 1:22) {
  
  setTxtProgressBar(pb, c)

  dat_100kb <- as.data.table(maps_100kb)[chrom == c & coverage > 0.5]
  setorder(dat_100kb, chromStart)

  # Compute gap and contiguous runs (rleid on whether gap equals expected_step)
  dat_100kb <- maps_100kb %>%
    filter(chrom == c, coverage > 0.5) %>%
    arrange(chromStart) %>%
    mutate(gap = chromStart - lag(chromStart, default = chromStart[1]))
  
  dat_100kb[1, gap := 0]

  # Define contiguous runs: TRUE when the spacing equals expected_step within tolerance
  dat_100kb[, contiguous := gap == 1e+5 | gap == 0]
  # rleid over contiguous TRUE/FALSE to get runs of "contiguous" status; keep only contiguous runs
  dat_100kb[, run_id := rleid(contiguous)]
  dat_100kb <- dat_100kb[contiguous == TRUE]

  # Now create group keys that combine run + plotting aesthetics to avoid over-splitting
  # Ensure factors for plotting columns exist
  dat_100kb[, constrained_model := as.character(constrained_model)]
  dat_100kb[, demo := as.character(demo)]
  dat_100kb[, mut_map := as.character(mut_map)]

  dat_100kb$constrained_model <- factor(dat_100kb$constrained_model,
    levels = c("func_merged_exons", "func_split_exons", "phastcons"))

  # Build a plotting group id: combine run_id with constrained_model (and any other aesthetics)
  dat_100kb[, plot_group := paste0("r", run_id, "_cm_", constrained_model)]

  p_100kb <- ggplot(dat_100kb, aes(x = chromStart / 1e6)) +
  facet_grid(demo ~ mut_map) + theme_bw() +
  # Observed pi: treat as its own color group; create a run-based group for continuity
  geom_path(data = dat_100kb, aes(y = avg_pi,
                                  color = "obs_pi", 
                                  group = paste0("r", run_id)), size = 0.75) +
  geom_point(data = dat_100kb, aes(y = avg_pi, 
                                   color = "obs_pi",
                                   group = paste0("r", run_id)), size = 1.5) +
  # Model predictions: draw lines only for non-small groups, always draw points
  geom_path(data = dat_100kb, 
            aes(y = exp_pi,
                color = constrained_model, 
                group = plot_group), size = 0.75) +
  geom_point(data = dat_100kb,
             aes(y = exp_pi, 
                 color = constrained_model, 
                 group = plot_group), size = 1.5) +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = pretty_breaks()) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("obs_pi" = "black",
                                "func_merged_exons" = "brown1",
                                "func_split_exons" = "purple3",
                                "phastcons" = "green4"),
    labels = c("obs. pi", "merged exons", "split exons", "phastcons")) +
  labs(title = NULL, x = "Position (Mb)", y = expression(pi)) +
  theme(strip.text.y = element_text(size = 16),
        strip.text.x = element_text(size = 16),
        axis.title.x = element_text(size = 16),
        axis.text.x = element_text(size = 12),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size = 12),
        axis.title.y = element_text(size = 14),
        plot.title = element_text(size = 20),
        legend.position = "bottom")
  
  b_100kb <- ggplot(dat_100kb, aes(x = chromStart / 1e6)) +
  facet_grid(demo ~ mut_map) + theme_bw() +
  # Model predictions: draw lines only for non-small groups, always draw points
  geom_path(data = dat_100kb,
            aes(y = B, 
                color = constrained_model, 
                group = plot_group), size = 0.75) +
  geom_point(data = dat_100kb,
             aes(y = B,
                 color = constrained_model,
                 group = plot_group), size = 1.5) +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = pretty_breaks()) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("func_merged_exons" = "brown1",
                                "func_split_exons" = "purple3",
                                "phastcons" = "green4"),
    labels = c("merged exons", "split exons", "phastcons")) +
  labs(title = NULL, x = "Position (Mb)", y = "B") +
  theme(strip.text.y = element_text(size = 16),
        strip.text.x = element_text(size = 16),
        axis.title.x = element_text(size = 16),
        axis.text.x = element_text(size = 12),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size = 12),
        axis.title.y = element_text(size = 14),
        plot.title = element_text(size = 20),
        legend.position = "bottom")
  
  dat_1Mb <- as.data.table(maps_1Mb)[chrom == c & coverage > 0.25]
  setorder(dat_1Mb, chromStart)

  # Compute gap and contiguous runs (rleid on whether gap equals expected_step)
  dat_1Mb <- maps_1Mb %>%
    filter(chrom == c, coverage > 0.75) %>%
    arrange(chromStart) %>%
    mutate(gap = chromStart - lag(chromStart, default = chromStart[1]))
  
  dat_1Mb[1, gap := 0]

  # Define contiguous runs: TRUE when the spacing equals expected_step within tolerance
  dat_1Mb[, contiguous := gap == 1e+6 | gap == 0]
  # rleid over contiguous TRUE/FALSE to get runs of "contiguous" status; keep only contiguous runs
  dat_1Mb[, run_id := rleid(contiguous)]
  dat_1Mb <- dat_1Mb[contiguous == TRUE]

  # Now create group keys that combine run + plotting aesthetics to avoid over-splitting
  # Ensure factors for plotting columns exist
  dat_1Mb[, constrained_model := as.character(constrained_model)]
  dat_1Mb[, demo := as.character(demo)]
  dat_1Mb[, mut_map := as.character(mut_map)]

  dat_1Mb$constrained_model <- factor(dat_1Mb$constrained_model,
    levels = c("func_merged_exons", 
               "func_split_exons", 
               "phastcons"))

  # Build a plotting group id: combine run_id with constrained_model (and any other aesthetics)
  dat_1Mb[, plot_group := paste0("r", run_id, "_cm_", constrained_model)]

  p_1Mb <- ggplot(dat_1Mb, aes(x = chromStart / 1e6)) +
  facet_grid(demo ~ mut_map) + theme_bw() +

  # Observed pi: treat as its own color group; create a run-based group for continuity
  geom_path(data = dat_1Mb, 
            aes(y = avg_pi, 
                color = "obs_pi", 
                group = paste0("r", run_id)), size = 0.75) +
  geom_point(data = dat_1Mb,
             aes(y = avg_pi,
                 color = "obs_pi", 
                 group = paste0("r", run_id)), size = 1.5) +
  # Model predictions: draw lines only for non-small groups, always draw points
  geom_path(data = dat_1Mb,
            aes(y = exp_pi, 
                color = constrained_model,
                group = plot_group), size = 0.75) +
  geom_point(data = dat_1Mb,
             aes(y = exp_pi,
                 color = constrained_model, 
                 group = plot_group), size = 1.5) +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = pretty_breaks()) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("obs_pi" = "black",
                                "func_merged_exons" = "brown1",
                                "func_split_exons" = "purple3",
                                "phastcons" = "green4"),
    labels = c("obs. pi", "merged exons", "split exons", "phastcons")) +
  labs(title = NULL, x = "Position (Mb)", y = expression(pi)) +
  theme(strip.text.y = element_text(size = 16),
        strip.text.x = element_text(size = 16),
        axis.title.x = element_text(size = 16),
        axis.text.x = element_text(size = 12),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size = 12),
        axis.title.y = element_text(size = 14),
        plot.title = element_text(size = 20),
        legend.position = "bottom")
  
  b_1Mb <- ggplot(dat_1Mb, aes(x = chromStart / 1e6)) +
  facet_grid(demo ~ mut_map) + theme_bw() +

  # Model predictions: draw lines only for non-small groups, always draw points
  geom_path(data = dat_1Mb, 
            aes(y = B, 
                color = constrained_model,
                group = plot_group), size = 0.75) +
  geom_point(data = dat_1Mb,
             aes(y = B,
                 color = constrained_model,
                 group = plot_group), size = 1.5) +

  scale_y_continuous(breaks = pretty_breaks()) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("func_merged_exons" = "brown1",
                                "func_split_exons" = "purple3",
                                "phastcons" = "green4"),
    labels = c("merged exons", "split exons", "phastcons")) +
  labs(title = NULL, x = "Position (Mb)", y = "B") +
  theme(trip.text.y = element_text(size = 16),
        strip.text.x = element_text(size = 16),
        axis.title.x = element_text(size = 16),
        axis.text.x = element_text(size = 12),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size = 12),
        axis.title.y = element_text(size = 14),
        plot.title = element_text(size = 20),
        legend.position = "bottom")
  
  save_plot(paste("real_data_maps/human_diversity_models_100kb_chr",
                  c, ".pdf", sep=""),
            p_100kb, base_height=12, base_width=24)
  
  save_plot(paste("real_data_maps/human_diversity_models_1Mb_chr",

  save_plot(paste("real_data_maps/human_B_models_100kb_chr",

            b_100kb, base_height=12, base_width=24)
  
  save_plot(paste("real_data_maps/human_B_models_1Mb_chr",
                  c, ".pdf", sep=""),
            b_1Mb, base_height=12, base_width=24)
}
close(pb)
```

Finding the parameter combination which results in simulated maps
most similar to the real ones 

Preparing the simulated maps

```{r sd-ac-maps, eval=F, include=F, message=F, warning=F}

# collecting simulated maps
muts_10kb <- as.data.frame(matrix(nrow=num_models*num_reps, ncol=1e+4))
recs_10kb <- as.data.frame(matrix(nrow=num_models*num_reps, ncol=1e+4))

muts_100kb <- as.data.frame(matrix(nrow=num_models*num_reps, ncol=1e+3))
recs_100kb <- as.data.frame(matrix(nrow=num_models*num_reps, ncol=1e+3))

muts_1Mb <- as.data.frame(matrix(nrow=num_models*num_reps, ncol=1e+2))
recs_1Mb <- as.data.frame(matrix(nrow=num_models*num_reps, ncol=1e+2))

pb <- txtProgressBar(min=0, max=num_models, style=3)
for(m in 1:num_models) {
  setTxtProgressBar(pb, m)
  for(rep in 1:num_reps) {
    maps_1kb <- fread(paste("model_", m,
                            "/rep_", rep, 
                            "/maps_1kb.csv.gz", sep=""))
    
    maps_1kb$bin_1kb <- 1:nrow(maps_1kb)
    maps_1kb$bin_10kb <- (maps_1kb$bin_1kb - 1) %/% 10
    maps_1kb$bin_100kb <- (maps_1kb$bin_1kb - 1) %/% 100
    maps_1kb$bin_1Mb <- (maps_1kb$bin_1kb - 1) %/% 1000
    
    maps_10kb <- maps_1kb %>% group_by(bin_10kb) %>% 
                 summarise_at(c("avg_mut", "avg_rec"), mean)
    maps_100kb <- maps_1kb %>% group_by(bin_100kb) %>% 
                  summarise_at(c("avg_mut", "avg_rec"), mean)
    maps_1Mb <- maps_1kb %>% group_by(bin_1Mb) %>% 
                summarise_at(c("avg_mut", "avg_rec"), mean)
    
    idx <- rep + (m - 1) * num_reps
    
    muts_10kb[idx,] <- maps_10kb$avg_mut
    recs_10kb[idx,] <- maps_10kb$avg_rec

    muts_100kb[idx,] <- maps_100kb$avg_mut
    recs_100kb[idx,] <- maps_100kb$avg_rec

    muts_1Mb[idx,] <- maps_1Mb$avg_mut
    recs_1Mb[idx,] <- maps_1Mb$avg_rec
  }
}
close(pb)

# mutation maps

muts_10kb$model <- sort(rep(1:num_models, num_reps))
muts_10kb$replicate <- rep(1:10, num_models)

names(muts_100kb) <- paste("bin", 1:ncol(muts_100kb), sep="_")
muts_100kb$model <- sort(rep(1:num_models, num_reps))
muts_100kb$replicate <- rep(1:10, num_models)

names(muts_1Mb) <- paste("bin", 1:ncol(muts_1Mb), sep="_")
muts_1Mb$model <- sort(rep(1:num_models, num_reps))
muts_1Mb$replicate <- rep(1:10, num_models)
  
# recombination maps
names(recs_10kb) <- paste("bin", 1:ncol(recs_10kb), sep="_")
recs_10kb$model <- sort(rep(1:num_models, num_reps))
recs_10kb$replicate <- rep(1:10, num_models)

names(recs_100kb) <- paste("bin", 1:ncol(recs_100kb), sep="_")

names(recs_1Mb) <- paste("bin", 1:ncol(recs_1Mb), sep="_")
recs_1Mb$model <- sort(rep(1:num_models, num_reps))
recs_1Mb$replicate <- rep(1:10, num_models)

fwrite(muts_10kb, "mut_maps_10kb_models.csv.gz")
fwrite(muts_100kb, "mut_maps_100kb_models.csv.gz")
fwrite(muts_1Mb, "mut_maps_1Mb_models.csv.gz")
  
fwrite(recs_10kb, "rec_maps_10kb_models.csv.gz")
fwrite(recs_100kb, "rec_maps_100kb_models.csv.gz")
fwrite(recs_1Mb, "rec_maps_1Mb_models.csv.gz")
```

```{r sd-ac-plots, eval=F, include=F, message=F, warning=F}
                                  values_to="mu",
                                  names_to="bin")

                                         mutate(cv_mut=sd(mu)/mean(mu)) %>%
                                         distinct(model,

                                                  .keep_all=T) %>%
                                         dplyr::select(., -bin)

muts_10kb_models$ac_mut <- apply(muts_10kb[,1:100], 1, # 1st order autocorrelation
                       function(x) as.numeric(unlist(acf(x, lag=1, pl=F))[2]))

muts_1Mb_models$ac_mut <- apply(muts_1Mb[,1:100], 1, # 1st order autocorrelation

muts <- rbind.data.frame(muts_10kb_models,

p <- ggplot(data=muts,

 geom_point(size=3) + theme_bw() +
 geom_point(data=human_summaries, 
            aes(x=ac_mut, y=cv_mut, color=mut_map),
            shape=4) +
 #geom_text(data=human_summaries, aes(label=chr), vjust=0.8, size=10) +
 facet_grid(scale~mult_r_u, labeller=label_both) +
 scale_shape_manual(values=c(0, 1, 2), name="Avg. Mut. Spans") + 
 # https://stats.stackexchange.com/questions/185425/how-to-determine-the-critical-values-of-acf
 geom_vline(xintercept=-1.96 / sqrt(100-1), color="grey", linetype="dashed") + 
 geom_vline(xintercept=1.96 / sqrt(100-1), color="grey", linetype="dashed") + 
 scale_color_manual(values=c("brown1", "green4", "purple3", "cyan3", 
                             "grey1", "blue", "orange"),
                    name="Shape=Rate Gamma") + 
 scale_y_continuous(breaks=pretty_breaks()) +
 scale_x_continuous(breaks=pretty_breaks()) +
 labs(title=NULL, x="AC (mutation rates)", y="CV (mutation rates)") +
 theme(strip.text.y=element_text(size=16),        
       strip.text.x=element_text(size=16),        
       axis.title=element_text(size=16), 
       axis.text=element_text(size=12), 
       axis.text.x=element_text(size=12),
       legend.text=element_text(size=16),
       legend.title=element_text(size=16),
       legend.position="bottom")
```

### Simulated pi

Specifying the models to be tested (with sim. pi, maps are true)

```{r dags-human-maps, include=F, eval=F}

D1 <- DAG(
  pi_sim_tot~prop_del_sites,
  pi_sim_tot~B,
  pi_sim_tot~avg_mut,
  B~avg_mut,
  B~avg_rec
)

D2 <- DAG(
  pi_sim_tot~prop_del_sites,
  pi_sim_tot~B,
  pi_sim_tot~avg_mut,
  B~avg_mut,
  B~avg_rec,
  B~prop_del_sites
)

D3 <- DAG(
  pi_sim_tot~prop_del_sites,
  pi_sim_tot~B,
  pi_sim_tot~avg_mut,
  B~avg_mut,
  B~avg_rec,
  B~prop_del_sites,
  avg_mut~avg_rec
)

D4 <- DAG(
  pi_sim_tot~prop_del_sites,
  pi_sim_tot~B,
  pi_sim_tot~avg_mut,
  B~avg_mut,
  B~avg_rec,
  B~prop_del_sites,
  avg_mut~avg_rec,
  # 2nd order selection on the mutation landscape?
  avg_mut~prop_del_sites
)

D5 <- DAG(

  pi_sim_tot~B,
  pi_sim_tot~avg_mut,
  B~avg_mut,
  B~avg_rec,
  B~prop_del_sites,
  avg_mut~avg_rec,
  # 2nd order selection on the mutation and recombination landscape?
  avg_mut~prop_del_sites,
  avg_rec~prop_del_sites
)
```

Testing the models

```{r dsep-humans-simpi, include=F, eval=F}

num_chrom <- 22
nboot <- 1e+3 # resampling the dataframe for reducing autocorrelation
  
# skipping 10kb scale because resampling is too expensive
for(u in unique(human_maps_100kb$mut_map)) {
  
  #tbl_100kb <- filter(human_maps_100kb, mut_map==u)
  #tbl_1Mb <- filter(human_maps_1Mb, mut_map==u)
  
  tbl_100kb <- human_maps_100kb[human_maps_100kb$mut_map==u,]
  tbl_1Mb <- human_maps_1Mb[human_maps_1Mb$mut_map==u,]
  
  for(m in 1:length(models_list)) {
    
    basis_set <- basiSet(models_list[[m]])
    weights <- rep(1, length=length(basis_set))
  
    #dsep_c_10kb <- as.data.frame(matrix(nrow=nboot, ncol=num_chrom))
    dsep_c_100kb <- as.data.frame(matrix(nrow=nboot, ncol=num_chrom))
    dsep_c_1Mb <- as.data.frame(matrix(nrow=nboot, ncol=num_chrom))
    
    #names(dsep_c_10kb) <-  paste("chr_", 1:num_chrom, sep="")
    names(dsep_c_100kb) <- paste("chr_", 1:num_chrom, sep="")
    names(dsep_c_1Mb) <-  paste("chr_", 1:num_chrom, sep="")
     
    for(c in 1:num_chrom) {
      
      cat(paste("DAG", m, "chromosome", c))
      cat("\n")
      
      # filtering for missing (obs) data and coverage to match real data tests
      
      #df_10kb <- filter(human_maps_10kb, 
      #                  chr==c,
      #                  coverage > 0.75, 
      #                  !is.na(avg_pi)) 
      
      df_100kb <- tbl_100kb[tbl_100kb$chr==c & 
                            tbl_100kb$num_sites > 7.5e+4 &
                            !is.na(tbl_100kb$avg_pi),] %>% as.data.table()
      
      df_1Mb <- tbl_1Mb[tbl_1Mb$chr==c & 
                        tbl_1Mb$num_sites > 5e+5 &
                        !is.na(tbl_1Mb$avg_pi),] %>% as.data.table()
      
      pb <- txtProgressBar(min=0, max=nboot, style=3) 
      for(b in 1:nboot) {
        
        setTxtProgressBar(pb, b)
    
        #samp_10kb <- sample_n(df_10kb, nrow(df_10kb), replace=T)
        samp_100kb <- sample_n(df_100kb, nrow(df_100kb), replace=T)
        samp_1Mb <- sample_n(df_1Mb, nrow(df_1Mb), replace=T)
        
        #pvals_10kb <- rep(NA, length(basis_set))
        pvals_100kb <- rep(NA, length(basis_set))
        pvals_1Mb <- rep(NA, length(basis_set))
    
        for(i in 1:length(basis_set)) {
          
          var1 <- basis_set[[i]][1]
          var2 <- basis_set[[i]][2]
          
          cond <- NULL
          if(length(basis_set[[i]]) > 2) {
            cond <- basis_set[[i]][3:length(basis_set[[i]])]
          }
          
          if(length(basis_set[[i]]) > 2) {
              #pvals_10kb[i] <- ppcor::pcor.test(samp_10kb[, ..var1], 
              #                                  samp_10kb[, ..var2], 
              #                                  samp_10kb[, ..cond],
              #                                  method="kendall")$p.value
              
              tryCatch({
                pvals_100kb[i] <- ppcor::pcor.test(samp_100kb[, ..var1], 
                                                 samp_100kb[, ..var2], 
                                                 samp_100kb[, ..cond],
                                                 method="kendall")$p.value
              }, error=function(e){cat("WARNING :",conditionMessage(e), "\n")})
              
              tryCatch({
                pvals_1Mb[i] <- ppcor::pcor.test(samp_1Mb[, ..var1], 
                                                 samp_1Mb[, ..var2], 
                                                 samp_1Mb[, ..cond],
                                                 method="kendall")$p.value
              }, error=function(e){cat("WARNING :",conditionMessage(e), "\n")})
          } else {
            #pvals_10kb[i] <- cor.test(samp_10kb[, ..var1][[1]],
            #                          samp_10kb[, ..var2][[1]],
            #                          method="kendall",
            #                          exact=F)$p.value
            
            pvals_100kb[i] <- cor.test(samp_100kb[, ..var1][[1]],
                                       samp_100kb[, ..var2][[1]],
                                       method="kendall",
                                       exact=F)$p.value
            
            pvals_1Mb[i] <- cor.test(samp_1Mb[, ..var1][[1]],
                                     samp_1Mb[, ..var2][[1]],
                                     method="kendall",
                                     exact=F)$p.value
          }
        }
        close(pb)
        
        #dsep_c_10kb[b, c] <- combine.test(pvals_10kb, weights, "fisher", na.rm=T)
        dsep_c_100kb[b, c] <- combine.test(pvals_100kb, weights, "fisher", na.rm=T)
        dsep_c_1Mb[b, c] <- combine.test(pvals_1Mb, weights, "fisher", na.rm=T)
      }
    }
    
    #fwrite(dsep_c_10kb, paste("real_data_maps/dsep_10kb_pisim_m",
    #                          i, ".csv.gz", sep=""))
    fwrite(dsep_c_100kb, paste("real_data_maps/dsep_100kb_pisim_m",
                               m, "_", u, ".csv.gz", sep=""))
    fwrite(dsep_c_1Mb, paste("real_data_maps/dsep_1Mb_pisim_m",
                              m, "_", u, ".csv.gz", sep=""))
  }
}
```

Processing files

```{r d-sep-plot, eval=F, include=F, message=F, warning=F}

# combines tables from previous chunks
pval_dsep_100kb <- list(length=length(models_list) *
                        length(unique(human_maps_100kb$mut_map)))

pval_dsep_1Mb <- list(length=length(models_list) *
                      length(unique(human_maps_1Mb$mut_map)))

for(i in 1:length(unique(human_maps_100kb$mut_map))) {
  for(m in 1:length(models_list)) {
    
    u <- unique(human_maps_100kb$mut_map)[i]
    
    fin_100kb <- paste("real_data_maps/dsep_100kb_pisim_m", m, 
                       "_", u, ".csv.gz", sep="")
    
    fin_1Mb <- paste("real_data_maps/dsep_1Mb_pisim_m", m, 
                     "_", u, ".csv.gz", sep="")
    
    pval_tbl_100kb <- fread(fin_100kb) 
    pval_tbl_1Mb <- fread(fin_1Mb) 
    
    pval_tbl_100kb$DAG <- m
    pval_tbl_1Mb$DAG <- m
    
    pval_tbl_100kb$mut_map <- u
    pval_tbl_1Mb$mut_map <- u
    
    pval_tbl_100kb$boot <- 1:nrow(pval_tbl_100kb)
    pval_tbl_1Mb$boot <- 1:nrow(pval_tbl_1Mb)
    
    idx <- i  + (m - 1) * length(unique(human_maps_100kb$mut_map))
    
    pval_dsep_100kb[[idx]] <- pval_tbl_100kb
    pval_dsep_1Mb[[idx]] <- pval_tbl_1Mb
  }
}

dsep_human_maps_100kb <- do.call(rbind.data.frame, pval_dsep_100kb)
dsep_human_maps_1Mb <- do.call(rbind.data.frame, pval_dsep_1Mb)

fwrite(dsep_human_maps_100kb,
       "real_data_maps/dsep_human_maps_100kb_pisim.csv.gz")

fwrite(dsep_human_maps_1Mb,
       "real_data_maps/dsep_human_maps_1Mb_pisim.csv.gz")
```

```{r dsep-humans-obspi, include=F, eval=F}
              }, error=function(e){cat("WARNING :",conditionMessage(e), "\n")})
              
              tryCatch({
                pvals_1Mb[i] <- ppcor::pcor.test(samp_1Mb[, ..var1], 
                                                 samp_1Mb[, ..var2], 
                                                 samp_1Mb[, ..cond],
                                                 method="kendall")$p.value
              }, error=function(e){cat("WARNING :",conditionMessage(e), "\n")})
          } else {
            #pvals_10kb[i] <- cor.test(samp_10kb[, ..var1][[1]],
            #                          samp_10kb[, ..var2][[1]],
            #                          method="kendall",
            #                          exact=F)$p.value
            
            pvals_100kb[i] <- cor.test(samp_100kb[, ..var1][[1]],
                                       samp_100kb[, ..var2][[1]],
                                       method="kendall",
                                       exact=F)$p.value
            
            pvals_1Mb[i] <- cor.test(samp_1Mb[, ..var1][[1]],
                                     samp_1Mb[, ..var2][[1]],
                                     method="kendall",
                                     exact=F)$p.value
          }
        }
        close(pb)
        
        #dsep_c_10kb[b, c] <- combine.test(pvals_10kb, weights, "fisher", na.rm=T)
        dsep_c_100kb[b, c] <- combine.test(pvals_100kb, weights, "fisher", na.rm=T)
        dsep_c_1Mb[b, c] <- combine.test(pvals_1Mb, weights, "fisher", na.rm=T)
      }
    }
    
    #fwrite(dsep_c_10kb, paste("real_data_maps/dsep_10kb_pisim_m",
    #                          i, ".csv.gz", sep=""))
    fwrite(dsep_c_100kb, paste("real_data_maps/dsep_100kb_piobs_m",
                               m, "_", u, ".csv.gz", sep=""))
    fwrite(dsep_c_1Mb, paste("real_data_maps/dsep_1Mb_piobs_m",
                              m, "_", u, ".csv.gz", sep=""))
  }
}
```

Processing files

```{r d-sep-plot, eval=F, include=F, message=F, warning=F}

# combines tables from previous chunks
pval_dsep_100kb <- list(length=length(models_list) *
                        length(unique(human_maps_100kb$mut_map)))

pval_dsep_1Mb <- list(length=length(models_list) *
                      length(unique(human_maps_1Mb$mut_map)))

for(i in 1:length(unique(human_maps_100kb$mut_map))) {
  for(m in 1:length(models_list)) {
    
    u <- unique(human_maps_100kb$mut_map)[i]
    
    fin_100kb <- paste("real_data_maps/dsep_100kb_piobs_m", m, 
                       "_", u, ".csv.gz", sep="")
    
    fin_1Mb <- paste("real_data_maps/dsep_1Mb_piobs_m", m, 
                     "_", u, ".csv.gz", sep="")
    
    pval_tbl_100kb <- fread(fin_100kb) 
    pval_tbl_1Mb <- fread(fin_1Mb) 
    
    pval_tbl_100kb$DAG <- m
    pval_tbl_1Mb$DAG <- m
    
    pval_tbl_100kb$mut_map <- u
    pval_tbl_1Mb$mut_map <- u
    
    pval_tbl_100kb$boot <- 1:nrow(pval_tbl_100kb)
    pval_tbl_1Mb$boot <- 1:nrow(pval_tbl_1Mb)
    
    idx <- i  + (m - 1) * length(unique(human_maps_100kb$mut_map))
    
    pval_dsep_100kb[[idx]] <- pval_tbl_100kb
    pval_dsep_1Mb[[idx]] <- pval_tbl_1Mb
  }
}

dsep_human_maps_100kb <- do.call(rbind.data.frame, pval_dsep_100kb)
dsep_human_maps_1Mb <- do.call(rbind.data.frame, pval_dsep_1Mb)

fwrite(dsep_human_maps_100kb,
       "real_data_maps/dsep_human_maps_100kb_piobs.csv.gz")

fwrite(dsep_human_maps_1Mb,
       "real_data_maps/dsep_human_maps_1Mb_piobs.csv.gz")
```

Combining simulated and observed pi, then plotting

```{r d-sep-plot, eval=F, include=F, message=F, warning=F}

# 100 kb
# combines tables from previous chunks
pval_dsep_pisim <- fread("real_data_maps/dsep_human_maps_100kb_pisim.csv.gz") 
pval_dsep_piobs <- fread("real_data_maps/dsep_human_maps_100kb_piobs.csv.gz") 

pval_dsep_pisim$pi <- "sim"
pval_dsep_piobs$pi <- "obs"

dsep_human_maps_100kb <- rbind.data.frame(pval_dsep_pisim,
                                          pval_dsep_piobs)

# it is handy to convert chr names to numeric
names(dsep_human_maps_100kb)[1:22] <- 1:num_chrom

m_dsep_human_100kb <- pivot_longer(dsep_human_maps_100kb,
                                   cols=1:num_chrom,
                                   names_to="chr", values_to="pval")
m_dsep_human_100kb$chr <- as.numeric(m_dsep_human_100kb$chr)

# testing the trend of avg pvalue vs chromosome id (~inverse of chr size)
x <- m_dsep_human_100kb %>% group_by(DAG, mut_map, pi, chr) %>% 
                          mutate(avg_p=mean(pval)) %>%
                          distinct(DAG, pi, chr, .keep_all=T) %>%
                          dplyr::select(DAG, pi, chr, avg_p)
y <- x %>% group_by(DAG, mut_map, pi) %>% 
           mutate(cor_pval_chrID_est=cor.test(avg_p, 
                                              chr, 
                                              method="kendall")$estimate,
                  cor_pval_chrID_pval=cor.test(avg_p, 
                                               chr,
                                               method="kendall")$p.value) %>% 
           distinct(DAG, pi, .keep_all=T) %>%
           dplyr::select(., c(DAG, pi, cor_pval_chrID_est, cor_pval_chrID_pval))

# helping viz
xsim <- filter(m_dsep_human_100kb, pi=="sim") %>% mutate(chr_p=chr - 0.1)  
xobs <- filter(m_dsep_human_100kb, pi=="obs") %>% mutate(chr_p=chr + 0.1)  

m_dsep_human_100kb <- rbind.data.frame(xsim, xobs)
m_dsep_human_100kb$chr_p <- as.factor(m_dsep_human_100kb$chr_p)
levels(m_dsep_human_100kb$chr_p) <- as.character(sort(rep(1:22, 2)))

num_boot <- max(m_dsep_human_100kb$boot)
p1 <- ggplot(data=filter(m_dsep_human_100kb), 
             aes(x=chr_p, 
                 y=-log10(pval), 
                 color=pi)) +
      geom_hline(aes(yintercept=-log10(0.05/(num_boot * num_chrom))), 
                 linetype="dashed", color="red") +
      #geom_violin(trim=FALSE, fill="white") + # gets misaligned by levels() <-
      geom_boxplot(width=0.25, fill="white", alpha=0.25)+
      facet_grid(mut_map~DAG, labeller=label_both) + theme_bw() + 
      scale_y_continuous(breaks=pretty_breaks()) +
      scale_x_discrete(breaks=as.character(sort(rep(1:22, 2)))) + 
      scale_color_manual(values=c("purple3", "seagreen4")) +
      guides(color=guide_legend(override.aes=list(alpha=1, shape=16, size=1))) +
      labs(title=paste("d-separation tests => H0: data based on human maps", 
                       "(100kb) fits DAG model (1000 bootstrap samples)"),
           x="Chromosome", y="-log10(p-value)") +
      theme(strip.text.y=element_text(size=16),     
            strip.text.x=element_text(size=16),      
            axis.title=element_text(size=16), 
            axis.text=element_text(size=12), 
            axis.text.x=element_text(size=12),
            legend.text=element_text(size=16),
            legend.title=element_text(size=16),
            legend.position="bottom")
save_plot("Manhattan/manhattan_d-sep_human_100kb.svg", p1, 
          base_height=15, base_width=25)

m_dsep_human_100kb$minuslog10pval <- -log10(m_dsep_human_100kb$pval)

pisim_tbl=filter(m_dsep_human_100kb, pi=="sim")
compare_means(pval ~ DAG,  data=pisim_tbl)
my_comparisons <- list(c("1", "2"),
                       c("2", "3"),
                       c("3", "4"),
                       c("4", "5"))

for(u in unique(pisim_tbl$mut_map)) {
  p2 <- ggpubr::ggboxplot(data=filter(pisim_tbl, mut_map==u),
                  x="DAG", 
                  y="minuslog10pval",
                  legend="bottom",
                  ylab="-log10(pval)",
                  title=paste("Difference in d-sep p-values (1000 bootstrap samples)", 
                         "between pairs of increasingly complex DAGs (sim. pi)")) +
        facet_wrap(~chr, ncol=4, labeller=label_both) +
        scale_y_continuous(breaks=pretty_breaks()) +
        stat_compare_means(comparisons=my_comparisons) + theme_bw() + 
        theme(strip.text.y=element_text(size=16),        
              strip.text.x=element_text(size=16),        
              plot.title=element_text(size=26),
              axis.title=element_text(size=24), 
              axis.text=element_text(size=16),
              strip.text.x=element_text(size=14))
  save_plot(paste("pairwise_d-sep_human_DAGs_pisim_100kb_", u, ".svg", sep=""),
            p2, base_height=24, base_width=30)
}
```

## Measurement models

Mutation rate/map

```{r measure-mut, eval=F, include=F, message=F, warning=F}

num_chrom <- 22

# roulette
roulette <- list(length=num_chrom)
for(c in 1:num_chrom) {
  roulette[[c]] <- fread(paste("~/Data/bgs_lmr/human_data/data/",
                               "mutation_tables/roulette/",
                               "roulette_tbl_chr", c, ".csv.gz", sep=""))
}
roulette_1kb <- do.call(rbind.data.frame, roulette)

names(roulette_1kb)[4:ncol(roulette_1kb)] <-
  paste(names(roulette_1kb)[4:ncol(roulette_1kb)],"roulette", sep="_")

# Carlson et al 2018
carlson <- list(length=num_chrom)
for(c in 1:num_chrom) {
  carlson[[c]] <- fread(paste("~/Data/bgs_lmr/human_data/data/",
                              "mutation_tables/carlson/",
                              "carlson_tbl_chr", c, ".csv.gz", sep=""))
}
carlson_1kb <- do.call(rbind.data.frame, carlson)

names(carlson_1kb)[4:ncol(carlson_1kb)] <- 
  paste(names(carlson_1kb)[4:ncol(carlson_1kb)], "carlson", sep="_")

# gnomad
gnomad <- list(length=num_chrom)
for(c in 1:num_chrom) {
  gnomad[[c]] <- fread(paste("~/Data/bgs_lmr/human_data/data/",
                             "mutation_tables/gnomad/",
                             "gnomad_tbl_chr", c, ".csv.gz", sep=""))
}
gnomad_1kb <- do.call(rbind.data.frame, gnomad)

names(gnomad_1kb)[4:ncol(gnomad_1kb)] <- 
  paste(names(gnomad_1kb)[4:ncol(gnomad_1kb)], "gnomad", sep="_")

mut_maps_1kb <- cbind.data.frame(roulette_1kb,
                                 carlson_1kb[,4:ncol(carlson_1kb)],
                                 gnomad_1kb[,4:ncol(gnomad_1kb)])

mut_maps_1kb <- mut_maps_1kb %>% group_by(chrom) %>% 
                                 mutate(bin_10kb=(1:n() - 1) %/% 10,
                                        bin_100kb=(1:n() - 1) %/% 100,
                                        bin_1Mb=(1:n() - 1) %/% 1000)

mut_maps_10kb <- mut_maps_1kb %>%
                 group_by(chrom, bin_10kb) %>% 
                 mutate(mean_mut_roulette=mean(avg_mut_roulette, na.rm=T),
                        mean_mut_masked_roulette=mean(avg_mut_masked_roulette, na.rm=T),
                        mean_mut_carlson=mean(avg_mut_carlson, na.rm=T),
                        mean_mut_masked_carlson=mean(avg_mut_masked_carlson, na.rm=T),
                        mean_mut_gnomad=mean(avg_mut_gnomad, na.rm=T),
                        mean_mut_masked_gnomad=mean(avg_mut_masked_gnomad, na.rm=T),
                        sum_sites_roulette=sum(num_sites_roulette, na.rm=T),
                        sum_sites_masked_roulette=sum(num_sites_masked_roulette, na.rm=T),
                        sum_sites_carlson=sum(num_sites_carlson, na.rm=T),
                        sum_sites_masked_carlson=sum(num_sites_masked_carlson, na.rm=T),
                        sum_sites_gnomad=sum(num_sites_gnomad, na.rm=T),
                        sum_sites_masked_gnomad=sum(num_sites_masked_gnomad, na.rm=T),
                        chromStart=min(chromStart),
                        chromEnd=max(chromEnd)) %>%
                 distinct(bin_10kb, .keep_all=T) %>%
                 ungroup() %>%
                 dplyr::select(., c(chrom, chromStart, chromEnd, 
                                    mean_mut_roulette,
                                    mean_mut_masked_roulette,
                                    mean_mut_masked_roulette,
                                    mean_mut_carlson,
                                    mean_mut_masked_carlson,
                                    mean_mut_gnomad,
                                    mean_mut_masked_gnomad,
                                    sum_sites_roulette,
                                    sum_sites_masked_roulette,
                                    sum_sites_carlson,
                                    sum_sites_masked_carlson,
                                    sum_sites_gnomad,
                                    sum_sites_masked_gnomad))
    
mut_maps_100kb <- mut_maps_1kb %>%
                  group_by(chrom, bin_100kb) %>% 
                  mutate(mean_mut_roulette=mean(avg_mut_roulette, na.rm=T),
                         mean_mut_masked_roulette=mean(avg_mut_masked_roulette, na.rm=T),
                         mean_mut_carlson=mean(avg_mut_carlson, na.rm=T),
                         mean_mut_masked_carlson=mean(avg_mut_masked_carlson, na.rm=T),
                         mean_mut_gnomad=mean(avg_mut_gnomad, na.rm=T),
                         mean_mut_masked_gnomad=mean(avg_mut_masked_gnomad, na.rm=T),
                         sum_sites_roulette=sum(num_sites_roulette, na.rm=T),
                         sum_sites_masked_roulette=sum(num_sites_masked_roulette, na.rm=T),
                         sum_sites_carlson=sum(num_sites_carlson, na.rm=T),
                         sum_sites_masked_carlson=sum(num_sites_masked_carlson, na.rm=T),
                         sum_sites_gnomad=sum(num_sites_gnomad, na.rm=T),
                         sum_sites_masked_gnomad=sum(num_sites_masked_gnomad, na.rm=T),
                         chromStart=min(chromStart),
                         chromEnd=max(chromEnd)) %>%
                  distinct(bin_100kb, .keep_all=T) %>%
                  ungroup() %>%
                  dplyr::select(., c(chrom, chromStart, chromEnd, 
                                     mean_mut_roulette,
                                     mean_mut_masked_roulette,
                                     mean_mut_masked_roulette,
                                     mean_mut_carlson,
                                     mean_mut_masked_carlson,
                                     mean_mut_gnomad,
                                     mean_mut_masked_gnomad,
                                     sum_sites_roulette,
                                     sum_sites_masked_roulette,
                                     sum_sites_carlson,
                                     sum_sites_masked_carlson,
                                     sum_sites_gnomad,
                                     sum_sites_masked_gnomad))

mut_maps_1Mb <- mut_maps_1kb %>%
                 group_by(chrom, bin_1Mb) %>% 
                 mutate(mean_mut_roulette=mean(avg_mut_roulette, na.rm=T),
                        mean_mut_masked_roulette=mean(avg_mut_masked_roulette, na.rm=T),
                        mean_mut_carlson=mean(avg_mut_carlson, na.rm=T),
                        mean_mut_masked_carlson=mean(avg_mut_masked_carlson, na.rm=T),
                        mean_mut_gnomad=mean(avg_mut_gnomad, na.rm=T),
                        mean_mut_masked_gnomad=mean(avg_mut_masked_gnomad, na.rm=T),
                        sum_sites_roulette=sum(num_sites_roulette, na.rm=T),
                        sum_sites_masked_roulette=sum(num_sites_masked_roulette, na.rm=T),
                        sum_sites_carlson=sum(num_sites_carlson, na.rm=T),
                        sum_sites_masked_carlson=sum(num_sites_masked_carlson, na.rm=T),
                        sum_sites_gnomad=sum(num_sites_gnomad, na.rm=T),
                        sum_sites_masked_gnomad=sum(num_sites_masked_gnomad, na.rm=T),
                        chromStart=min(chromStart),
                        chromEnd=max(chromEnd)) %>%
                 distinct(bin_1Mb, .keep_all=T) %>%
```
