## SEM

### Helper functions

```{r SEM-helpers-1, eval=F, include=F, message=F, warning=F}

# 1) distance-aware blocks (returns copy)
make_distance_blocks <- function(dt_chr, window_bp, max_block_span = 1e6, gap_factor = 2L) {
  if (!"data.table" %in% class(dt_chr)) dt_chr <- as.data.table(dt_chr)
  max_gap <- as.numeric(window_bp) * as.numeric(gap_factor)
  pos <- dt_chr$midpoint
  gaps <- c(0, diff(pos))
  block_id <- cumsum(gaps > max_gap) + 1L
  dt_chr[, block_id := block_id]
  dt_chr[, span := max(midpoint) - min(midpoint), by = block_id]
  if (any(dt_chr$span > max_block_span)) {
    window_limit <- max(2L, floor(max_block_span / window_bp))
    dt_chr[, block_seq := seq_len(.N), by = block_id]
    dt_chr[, block_id2 := block_id + floor((block_seq - 1L) / window_limit)]
    dt_chr[, `:=`(block_id = block_id2)]
    dt_chr[, c("block_seq", "block_id2", "span") := NULL]
  } else {
    dt_chr[, span := NULL]
  }
  copy(dt_chr)
}

# -------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 2) estimate_decay_per_chr_robust
#    Robustly estimate an exponential covariance decay (sigma2 * exp(-alpha d))
#    from residuals of a linear model on a single chromosome (or subset).
#    Returns a list with alpha, sigma2, method, n_pairs, n_bins, binned (data.table)
# -------------------------------------------------------------------------
estimate_decay_per_chr_robust <- function(dt_chr,
                                          formula = NULL,
                                          resp = NULL,
                                          predictors = NULL,
                                          min_pairs = 30L,
                                          max_pair_distance = 2e5,
                                          n_bins = 50L,
                                          trim_prop = 0.02,
                                          start_alpha = 1e-6,
                                          start_s2 = NULL,
                                          lower_alpha = 1e-12,
                                          upper_alpha = 1,
                                          lower_s2 = 1e-12,
                                          upper_s2 = Inf,
                                          nls_control = nls.control(warnOnly = TRUE, maxiter = 200),
                                          min_sigma2 = 1e-8,
                                          min_alpha = 1e-10,
                                          borrow_alpha = NA_real_,    # scalar fallback alpha (optional)
                                          return_binned = TRUE,
                                          verbose = FALSE) {
  # Input checks
  if (!"data.table" %in% class(dt_chr)) dt_chr <- as.data.table(dt_chr)
  if (!is.null(formula) && (!is.null(resp) || !is.null(predictors))) {
    stop("Supply either 'formula' OR ('resp' and 'predictors'), not both.")
  }
  if (is.null(formula) && (is.null(resp) || is.null(predictors))) {
    stop("Either 'formula' or both 'resp' and 'predictors' must be supplied.")
  }
  if (!is.null(formula)) {
    ols <- tryCatch(lm(formula, data = dt_chr), error = function(e) e)
  } else {
    fml <- as.formula(sprintf("%s ~ %s", resp, paste(predictors, collapse = " + ")))
    ols <- tryCatch(lm(fml, data = dt_chr), error = function(e) e)
  }
  if (inherits(ols, "error")) {
    return(list(alpha = NA_real_, sigma2 = NA_real_, method = "ols_fail", n_pairs = 0L,
                n_bins = 0L, binned = NULL))
  }

  resid_vec <- resid(ols)
  pos <- dt_chr$midpoint
  n_windows <- length(resid_vec)
  if (n_windows < 4) {
    return(list(alpha = NA_real_, sigma2 = var(resid_vec, na.rm = TRUE),
                method = "insufficient_windows", n_pairs = 0L, n_bins = 0L, binned = NULL))
  }

  # Pairwise distances and covariances (lower triangular)
  # Use efficient vectors rather than storing full matrices where possible
  dmat <- as.matrix(dist(pos))   # acceptable for typical block sizes; if very large, call with smaller blocks
  cov_mat <- outer(resid_vec, resid_vec, "*")
  dvec <- dmat[lower.tri(dmat)]
  cov_pairs <- cov_mat[lower.tri(cov_mat)]

  ok_idx <- which(is.finite(dvec) & is.finite(cov_pairs) & dvec <= max_pair_distance)
  if (length(ok_idx) < min_pairs) {
    return(list(alpha = NA_real_, sigma2 = var(resid_vec, na.rm = TRUE),
                method = "insufficient_pairs", n_pairs = length(ok_idx), n_bins = 0L, binned = NULL))
  }

  d_ok <- dvec[ok_idx]; cov_ok <- cov_pairs[ok_idx]

  # Bin distances (equal-width up to max_pair_distance)
  breaks <- seq(0, max_pair_distance, length.out = as.integer(n_bins) + 1L)
  bin_idx <- cut(d_ok, breaks = breaks, include.lowest = TRUE, labels = FALSE)
  bin_dt <- data.table(d = d_ok, cov = cov_ok, bin = bin_idx)
  binned <- bin_dt[, {
    if (.N < 3) .(dmed = median(d), cov_trim = NA_real_, n = .N)
    else {
      lo <- quantile(cov, probs = trim_prop, na.rm = TRUE)
      hi <- quantile(cov, probs = 1 - trim_prop, na.rm = TRUE)
      cov_t <- cov[cov >= lo & cov <= hi]
      cov_mean <- if (length(cov_t) == 0) NA_real_ else mean(cov_t, na.rm = TRUE)
      .(dmed = median(d), cov_trim = cov_mean, n = .N)
    }
  }, by = bin][!is.na(cov_trim) & n > 0]

  if (nrow(binned) < 4) {
    return(list(alpha = NA_real_, sigma2 = var(resid_vec, na.rm = TRUE),
                method = "insufficient_bins", n_pairs = length(ok_idx), n_bins = nrow(binned),
                binned = if (return_binned) binned else NULL))
  }

  # start values
  s2_start <- if (!is.null(start_s2)) start_s2 else max(min_sigma2, var(resid_vec, na.rm = TRUE))
  alpha_start <- max(start_alpha, min_alpha)

  # Prepare for NLS: if any cov_trim <= 0, shift for nls
  cov_b <- binned$cov_trim
  d_b <- binned$dmed
  cov_shift <- 0
  if (any(cov_b <= 0, na.rm = TRUE)) {
    cov_shift <- abs(min(cov_b, na.rm = TRUE)) + 1e-12
    cov_b_nls <- cov_b + cov_shift
  } else cov_b_nls <- cov_b

  # robust constrained NLS attempt
  nls_fit <- tryCatch({
    nls(cov_b_nls ~ s2 * exp(-alpha * d_b),
        start = list(s2 = s2_start + cov_shift, alpha = alpha_start),
        algorithm = "port",
        lower = c(s2 = lower_s2, alpha = lower_alpha),
        upper = c(s2 = upper_s2 + cov_shift, alpha = upper_alpha),
        control = nls_control)
  }, error = function(e) e, warning = function(w) w)

  method_used <- NA_character_
  alpha_hat <- NA_real_; s2_hat <- NA_real_

  if (!inherits(nls_fit, "error") && !inherits(nls_fit, "warning")) {
    coefs <- coef(nls_fit)
    s2_hat <- as.numeric(coefs["s2"]) - cov_shift
    alpha_hat <- as.numeric(coefs["alpha"])
    method_used <- "nls_binned"
  } else {
    # fallback: log-linear regression on strictly positive covariances
    ok_log_idx <- which(cov_b > 0 & is.finite(cov_b) & is.finite(d_b))
    if (length(ok_log_idx) >= 3) {
      lm_fit <- tryCatch(lm(log(cov_b[ok_log_idx]) ~ d_b[ok_log_idx]), error = function(e) e)
      if (!inherits(lm_fit, "error")) {
        coef_lm <- coef(lm_fit)
        log_s2_hat <- as.numeric(coef_lm[1])
        alpha_hat <- -as.numeric(coef_lm[2])
        s2_hat <- exp(log_s2_hat)
        method_used <- "loglinear_binned"
      }
    }
  }

  # Last-resort: fallback to empirical residual variance if no fit
  if (is.na(s2_hat) || !is.finite(s2_hat)) {
    s2_hat <- var(resid_vec, na.rm = TRUE)
    method_used <- if (is.na(method_used)) "fallback_variance" else paste(method_used, "fallback_variance", sep = "+")
  }
  if (is.na(alpha_hat) || !is.finite(alpha_hat)) {
    alpha_hat <- NA_real_
  }

  # Automatic artifact handling
  fallback_reasons <- character(0)
  if (is.na(s2_hat) || s2_hat < min_sigma2) {
    if (!is.na(borrow_alpha) && is.finite(borrow_alpha)) {
      s2_hat <- max(min_sigma2, var(resid_vec, na.rm = TRUE))
    } else {
      s2_hat <- max(min_sigma2, var(resid_vec, na.rm = TRUE))
    }
    fallback_reasons <- c(fallback_reasons, "sigma2_too_small")
    method_used <- paste0(method_used, "+sigma2_fixed")
  }
  if (is.na(alpha_hat) || alpha_hat < min_alpha) {
    if (!is.na(borrow_alpha) && is.finite(borrow_alpha)) {
      alpha_hat <- borrow_alpha
      method_used <- paste0(method_used, "+alpha_borrowed")
      fallback_reasons <- c(fallback_reasons, "alpha_borrowed")
    } else {
      # set minimal positive alpha to avoid exactly zero
      alpha_hat <- min_alpha
      method_used <- paste0(method_used, "+alpha_min_forced")
      fallback_reasons <- c(fallback_reasons, "alpha_forced_min")
    }
  }

  if (verbose) {
    message("estimate_decay_per_chr_robust: method=", method_used, " alpha=", signif(alpha_hat,4),
            " sigma2=", signif(s2_hat,4), " n_bins=", nrow(binned))
  }

  out <- list(alpha = alpha_hat,
              sigma2 = s2_hat,
              method = method_used,
              n_pairs = length(ok_idx),
              n_bins = nrow(binned),
              binned = if (return_binned) binned else NULL,
              fallback_reasons = if (length(fallback_reasons)) paste(fallback_reasons, collapse = ";") else NA_character_)
  out
}

# -------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 3) make_block_specs_robust
#    Build distance-aware blocks, estimate decay per chromosome and variable,
#    automatically apply fallbacks (borrowing alpha, fixing sigma2) and log
#    diagnostics. Returns list(block_map = data.table, decay_dt = data.table)
# -------------------------------------------------------------------------
make_block_specs_robust <- function(dt,
                                    vars,
                                    by_chr = "chrom",
                                    window_bp = NULL,
                                    max_block_span = 1e6,
                                    max_pair_distance = 2e5,
                                    n_bins = 50L,
                                    trim_prop = 0.02,
                                    min_pairs = 30L,
                                    min_sigma2 = 1e-8,
                                    min_alpha = 1e-10,
                                    borrow_alpha_from = NULL, # vector of chromosomes to borrow from, or NULL to use median of successful fits
                                    verbose = FALSE,
                                    ...) {
  if (!"data.table" %in% class(dt)) dt <- as.data.table(dt)
  stopifnot(by_chr %in% names(dt), "midpoint" %in% names(dt))
  # preserve original row index for safe mapping later
  dt[, orig_row__ := .I]

  # Build distance-aware blocks per chromosome by splitting (safe: make_distance_blocks modifies input)
  if (!is.null(window_bp)) {
    dt_list <- split(dt, by = by_chr, keep.by = TRUE)
    dt_blocks_list <- lapply(dt_list, function(dsub) {
      setDT(dsub)
      make_distance_blocks(dsub, window_bp = window_bp, max_block_span = max_block_span)
    })
    dt_blocks <- rbindlist(dt_blocks_list, use.names = TRUE, fill = TRUE)
  } else {
    dt_blocks <- copy(dt)
    dt_blocks[, block_id := 1L, by = by_chr]
  }
  # Ensure mapping to original rows
  if (!"orig_row__" %in% names(dt_blocks)) stop("orig_row__ missing from block map; ensure dt had orig_row__ before splitting.")
  block_map <- dt_blocks[, .(orig_row = orig_row__, chrom = get(by_chr), midpoint, block_id)]

  # For each chromosome and variable, run robust estimator and collect binned objects
  decay_records <- list()
  fits_by_var_chr <- list()  # temporary storage for alpha extraction
  for (varname in names(vars)) {
    preds <- vars[[varname]]
    dts_by_chr <- split(dt_blocks, by = by_chr, keep.by = TRUE)
    for (chr_val in names(dts_by_chr)) {
      dt_chr <- dts_by_chr[[chr_val]]
      # call estimator with conservative defaults
      res <- tryCatch(
        estimate_decay_per_chr_robust(dt_chr,
                                      resp = varname,
                                      predictors = preds,
                                      min_pairs = min_pairs,
                                      max_pair_distance = max_pair_distance,
                                      n_bins = n_bins,
                                      trim_prop = trim_prop,
                                      min_sigma2 = min_sigma2,
                                      min_alpha = min_alpha,
                                      return_binned = TRUE,
                                      verbose = FALSE,
                                      ...),
        error = function(e) {
          list(alpha = NA_real_, sigma2 = NA_real_, method = "est_error", n_pairs = 0L, n_bins = 0L, binned = NULL, fallback_reasons = NA_character_)
        })
      fits_by_var_chr[[paste(varname, chr_val, sep = "___")]] <- list(chr = chr_val, var = varname, res = res)
      # populate record now but may adjust later if borrowing alpha applied
      decay_records[[length(decay_records) + 1]] <- data.table(
        chrom = as.character(chr_val),
        variable = varname,
        alpha = res$alpha,
        sigma2 = res$sigma2,
        n_windows = nrow(dt_chr),
        n_pairs = res$n_pairs %||% NA_integer_,
        method = res$method %||% NA_character_,
        fallback_reasons = res$fallback_reasons %||% NA_character_,
        binned = list(res$binned)
      )
    }
  }

  decay_dt <- rbindlist(decay_records, use.names = TRUE, fill = TRUE)

  # Determine alpha borrowing source if any alphas are missing or too small
  # Compute median alpha across successful fits (optionally restricted to borrow_alpha_from)
  success_alphas <- decay_dt[is.finite(alpha) & !is.na(alpha) & alpha > 0, .(alpha, chrom, variable)]
  alpha_pool <- success_alphas$alpha
  if (!is.null(borrow_alpha_from)) {
    # restrict alpha_pool to requested chromosomes if present
    alpha_pool <- success_alphas[chrom %in% as.character(borrow_alpha_from), alpha]
  }
  median_alpha_pool <- if (length(alpha_pool) > 0) median(alpha_pool, na.rm = TRUE) else NA_real_
  if (is.na(median_alpha_pool)) {
    # fallback guess if no pool available
    median_alpha_pool <- 1e-6
    if (verbose) message("No valid alpha pool found; using default median_alpha_pool = ", median_alpha_pool)
  }

  # Apply automatic fixes: where sigma2 is NA or < min_sigma2 --> replace with empirical residual variance
  # where alpha is NA or < min_alpha --> borrow median_alpha_pool
  decay_dt[, `:=`(
    sigma2_orig = sigma2,
    alpha_orig = alpha
  )]
  for (i in seq_len(nrow(decay_dt))) {
    row <- decay_dt[i]
    chr_val <- row$chr; varname <- row$variable
    if (is.na(row$sigma2) || row$sigma2 < min_sigma2) {
      # compute empirical residual variance on that chr/var to be stable
      dt_chr_full <- dt_blocks[get(by_chr) == chr_val]
      if (nrow(dt_chr_full) >= 2 && var(dt_chr_full[[varname]], na.rm = TRUE) > 0) {
        new_sigma2 <- var(resid(lm(as.formula(sprintf("%s ~ %s", varname, paste(vars[[varname]], collapse = " + "))), data = dt_chr_full)), na.rm = TRUE)
        if (!is.finite(new_sigma2) || new_sigma2 < min_sigma2) new_sigma2 <- max(min_sigma2, var(dt_chr_full[[varname]], na.rm = TRUE))
      } else {
        new_sigma2 <- max(min_sigma2, ifelse(is.finite(row$sigma2), row$sigma2 %||% min_sigma2, min_sigma2))
      }
      decay_dt[i, `:=`(sigma2 = new_sigma2,
                       method = paste0(method %||% "unknown", "+sigma2_fixed"),
                       fallback_reasons = ifelse(is.na(fallback_reasons), "sigma2_fixed", paste(fallback_reasons, "sigma2_fixed", sep = ";")))]
      if (verbose) message("Fixed sigma2 for ", varname, " chrom ", chr_val, " -> ", signif(new_sigma2,4))
    }
    if (is.na(row$alpha) || row$alpha < min_alpha) {
      decay_dt[i, `:=`(alpha = median_alpha_pool,
                       method = paste0(method %||% "unknown", "+alpha_borrowed"),
                       fallback_reasons = ifelse(is.na(fallback_reasons), "alpha_borrowed", paste(fallback_reasons, "alpha_borrowed", sep = ";")))]
      if (verbose) message("Borrowed alpha for ", varname, " chrom ", chr_val, " -> ", signif(median_alpha_pool,4))
    }
  }

  # Return block_map and decay_dt (binned retained as list column)
  setcolorder(decay_dt, c("chrom", "variable", "alpha", "sigma2", "n_windows", "n_pairs", "method", "fallback_reasons", "binned", "alpha_orig", "sigma2_orig"))
  list(block_map = block_map, decay_dt = decay_dt[])
}

# 4) build_exp_cov: build sparse exp covariance for positions
build_exp_cov <- function(pos, alpha, sigma2, max_pair_distance = Inf, tol = 1e-12) {
  n <- length(pos)
  if (n == 0) return(Matrix(0, 0, 0, sparse = TRUE))
  dmat <- as.matrix(dist(pos))
  if (is.na(alpha) || !is.finite(alpha)) {
    return(Diagonal(n = n, x = rep(sigma2, n)))
  }
  cov_mat <- sigma2 * exp(-alpha * dmat)
  cov_mat[dmat > max_pair_distance] <- 0
  cov_mat[abs(cov_mat) < tol] <- 0
  as(Matrix(cov_mat, sparse = TRUE), "dsCMatrix")
}

# 5) make_sparse_cov_blocks: map decay_dt -> sparse blocks
make_sparse_cov_blocks <- function(block_map,
                                   decay_dt,
                                   dt,
                                   by_chr = "chrom",
                                   max_pair_distance = 2e5,
                                   verbose = FALSE) {
  # Defensive checks
  stopifnot("data.table" %in% class(block_map), "data.table" %in% class(decay_dt), "data.table" %in% class(dt))
  stopifnot(by_chr %in% names(block_map), by_chr %in% names(dt), "variable" %in% names(decay_dt), by_chr %in% names(decay_dt))
  block_map[[by_chr]] <- as.character(block_map[[by_chr]])
  decay_dt[[by_chr]] <- as.character(decay_dt[[by_chr]])
  dt[[by_chr]] <- as.character(dt[[by_chr]])

  # Initialize output
  full_block_covs <- list()
  block_diagnostics <- list()

  # Loop over unique blocks
  unique_blocks <- unique(block_map[, .(block_id, chrom = get(by_chr))])
  for (i in seq_len(nrow(unique_blocks))) {
    block_id <- unique_blocks$block_id[i]
    chr_val <- unique_blocks$chrom[i]

    # Subset block rows
    block_rows <- block_map[block_id == block_id & get(by_chr) == chr_val]
    if (nrow(block_rows) == 0) next

    # Subset data
    dt_block <- dt[block_rows$orig_row]
    if (nrow(dt_block) < 2) next

    # Get decay parameters
    decay_row <- decay_dt[get(by_chr) == chr_val & variable %in% names(dt_block)]
    if (nrow(decay_row) == 0) {
      if (verbose) message("No decay estimate for chr ", chr_val, " block ", block_id)
      next
    }

    alpha <- decay_row$alpha[1]
    sigma2 <- decay_row$sigma2[1]
    method <- decay_row$method[1]
    fallback <- decay_row$fallback_reasons[1]

    # Build exponential covariance matrix
    pos <- dt_block$midpoint
    dmat <- as.matrix(dist(pos))
    cov_mat <- sigma2 * exp(-alpha * dmat)

    # Store
    full_block_covs[[paste(chr_val, block_id, sep = "_")]] <- cov_mat
    block_diagnostics[[paste(chr_val, block_id, sep = "_")]] <- list(
      chr = chr_val,
      block_id = block_id,
      n_windows = nrow(dt_block),
      alpha = alpha,
      sigma2 = sigma2,
      method = method,
      fallback = fallback
    )
  }

  # Return
  diagnostics_dt <- rbindlist(lapply(block_diagnostics, as.data.table), use.names = TRUE, fill = TRUE)
  list(full_block_covs = full_block_covs, diagnostics = diagnostics_dt)
}

# 6) Prewhiten variables blockwise
prewhiten_variable_blockwise <- function(varname, dt_sub, sparse_obj) {
  pattern <- paste0(":::", varname, "$")
  keys <- names(sparse_obj$full_block_covs)[grepl(pattern, names(sparse_obj$full_block_covs))]
  whitened <- rep(NA_real_, nrow(dt_sub))
  for (key in keys) {
    cov_mat <- sparse_obj$full_block_covs[[key]]
    idx_dt <- sparse_obj$index_map[variable == varname & paste(chrom, variable, sep = ":::") == key]
    if (nrow(idx_dt) == 0) next
    idx_order <- idx_dt[order(idx), row_id]
    y_block <- dt_sub[idx_order, get(varname)]
    if (length(y_block) == 0) next
    cov_dense <- as.matrix(cov_mat)
    jitter_eps <- 1e-8 * max(1, mean(diag(cov_dense)))
    diag(cov_dense) <- diag(cov_dense) + jitter_eps
    L <- NULL
    try({ L <- chol(cov_dense) }, silent = TRUE)
    if (!is.null(L)) {
      whiten_block <- backsolve(L, forwardsolve(t(L), y_block))
      whitened[idx_order] <- whiten_block
    } else {
      eig <- eigen(cov_dense, symmetric = TRUE)
      vals_adj <- pmax(eig$values, 1e-12)
      P_sqrt <- eig$vectors %*% diag(1 / sqrt(vals_adj)) %*% t(eig$vectors)
      whiten_block <- as.numeric(P_sqrt %*% y_block)
      whitened[idx_order] <- whiten_block
    }
  }
  whitened
}

# 7) wrapper that applies blockwise whitening to a set of variables
prewhiten_all_variables <- function(dt_sub,
                                    vars,
                                    sparse_obj,
                                    whiten_suffix = "_wh",
                                    assemble_cov = FALSE,
                                    cov_assembler = assemble_cov_for_variable,
                                    parallel = FALSE,
                                    BPPARAM = BiocParallel::SerialParam(),
                                    verbose = TRUE) {
  # dt_sub        : data.table with the original windows (must match index_map row_id)
  # vars          : character vector of variable names to whiten
  # sparse_obj    : output of make_sparse_cov_blocks() with $full_block_covs and $index_map
  # whiten_suffix : suffix appended to var name for whitened column (default "_wh")
  # assemble_cov  : if TRUE, also build block-diagonal covariance (via cov_assembler) for each var
  # cov_assembler : function(full_block_covs, decay_dt, varname) -> blockDiag matrix or NULL
  # parallel      : if TRUE uses BiocParallel to whiten variables in parallel
  # BPPARAM       : BiocParallel parameter object (ignored unless parallel = TRUE)
  # verbose       : print progress messages

  stopifnot("data.table" %in% class(dt_sub))
  stopifnot(is.list(sparse_obj) && all(c("full_block_covs", "index_map") %in% names(sparse_obj)))
  if (!all(vars %in% names(dt_sub))) stop("Some vars not present in dt_sub")

  # Prepare result containers
  dt_out <- copy(dt_sub)
  diagnostics <- data.table(variable = vars,
                            n_obs = NA_integer_,
                            n_whitened = NA_integer_,
                            prop_na = NA_real_,
                            cov_built = FALSE,
                            stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  cov_list <- list()
  names(cov_list) <- vars

  # Worker function for single variable
  whiten_one <- function(varname) {
    if (verbose) message("Whitening variable: ", varname)
    # run blockwise prewhitening (uses sparse_obj)
    whitened_vec <- try(prewhiten_variable_blockwise(varname = varname,
                                                     dt_sub = dt_sub,
                                                     sparse_obj = sparse_obj), silent = TRUE)
    if (inherits(whitened_vec, "try-error")) {
      warning("Whitening failed for variable ", varname, ": ", conditionMessage(attr(whitened_vec, "condition")))
      whitened_vec <- rep(NA_real_, nrow(dt_sub))
      cov_built <- FALSE
      cov_mat <- NULL
    } else {
      # assemble covariance optionally
      if (assemble_cov) {
        cov_mat <- try(cov_assembler(sparse_obj$full_block_covs, NULL, varname), silent = TRUE)
        if (inherits(cov_mat, "try-error")) {
          warning("Covariance assembly failed for variable ", varname)
          cov_mat <- NULL
          cov_built <- FALSE
        } else cov_built <- !is.null(cov_mat)
      } else {
        cov_mat <- NULL
        cov_built <- FALSE
      }
    }
    list(var = varname, whitened = whitened_vec, cov = cov_mat, cov_built = cov_built)
  }

  # Run for all variables (serial or parallel)
  if (parallel) {
    if (!requireNamespace("BiocParallel", quietly = TRUE)) {
      stop("BiocParallel required for parallel = TRUE. Install it or set parallel = FALSE.")
    }
    res_list <- BiocParallel::bplapply(vars, FUN = whiten_one, BPPARAM = BPPARAM)
  } else {
    res_list <- lapply(vars, whiten_one)
  }

  # Attach whitened columns and collect diagnostics
  for (res in res_list) {
    var <- res$var
    wcol <- paste0(var, whiten_suffix)
    dt_out[, (wcol) := res$whitened]
    n_obs <- sum(!is.na(dt_sub[[var]]))
    n_whitened <- sum(!is.na(res$whitened))
    prop_na <- mean(is.na(res$whitened))
    diagnostics[variable == var, `:=`(n_obs = n_obs, n_whitened = n_whitened, prop_na = prop_na, cov_built = res$cov_built)]
    if (!is.null(res$cov)) cov_list[[var]] <- res$cov
  }

  # Return structured result
  ret <- list(dt_whitened = dt_out,
              diagnostics = diagnostics,
              cov_list = cov_list,
              sparse_obj = sparse_obj)
  class(ret) <- c("prewhiten_all_result", class(ret))
  ret
}

# For variable 'v', assemble block-diagonal covariance across all chromosomes in decay_dt
assemble_cov_for_variable <- function(full_block_covs, decay_dt, varname) {
  keys <- names(full_block_covs)[grepl(paste0(":::", varname, "$"), names(full_block_covs))]
  mats <- lapply(keys, function(k) full_block_covs[[k]])
  if (length(mats) == 0) return(NULL)
  # blockDiag from Matrix
  do.call(bdiag, mats)
}

# Suppose windows are ordered and same row_id order for all variables.
# vars_order is c("avg_pi","B","avg_mut")
# index_map ties row positions to original rows.
build_full_sample_cov_for_lavaan <- function(dt, vars_order, full_block_covs, index_map) {
  # number of windows
  n_windows <- nrow(dt)
  p <- length(vars_order)
  # Full covariance is (p * n) x (p * n) if you stack variables per window; usually too big.
  # Instead compute covariance across variables (p x p) using aggregated summaries:
  # Option A: compute covariance of window-wise averages (collapsed to sample of windows).
  window_mat <- as.matrix(dt[, ..vars_order])
  sample_cov_vars <- cov(window_mat, use = "pairwise.complete.obs")
  list(sample_cov_vars = sample_cov_vars, n_obs = nrow(window_mat))
}

# Helper wrapper for plotting diagnostics (optional)
plot_decay_diagnostics <- function(binned, alpha = NA_real_, sigma2 = NA_real_, chr_label = NULL) {
  if (is.null(binned) || nrow(binned) == 0) stop("No binned data to plot")
  ggplot(binned, aes(x = dmed, y = cov_trim)) +
    geom_point() +
    geom_line() +
    labs(x = "Distance (bp)", y = "Binned covariance (trimmed mean)", title = paste0("Empirical binned covariance", if (!is.null(chr_label)) paste0(" - chrom ", chr_label) else "")) +
    theme_minimal() +
    {if (!is.na(alpha) && !is.na(sigma2)) {
      stat_function(fun = function(x) sigma2 * exp(-alpha * x), color = "steelblue", size = 1)
    } else NULL}
}
```

Helpers to build model strings with starting values for candidate covariances

```{r SEM-helpers-2, eval=F, include=F, message=F, warning=F}

# build pair keys table from pairs_list_k_flat-like structure
collect_pair_keys <- function(pairs_list_k_flat) {
  if (length(pairs_list_k_flat) == 0) return(NULL)
  rows <- map_dfr(pairs_list_k_flat, function(pl) {
    if (length(pl) == 0) return(NULL)
    map_dfr(pl, ~ tibble(i = .x$i, j = .x$j, cov = .x$cov))
  })
  if (nrow(rows) == 0) return(NULL)
  unique(rows)
}

# generic builder that injects start values for avg_pi covariances
build_generic_model_for_k <- function(k, pairs_list_k_flat, structural_lines, derived_lines = character(0)) {
  lines <- character(0)
  for (i in 1:k) {
    suf <- paste0("_", i)
    lines <- c(lines, gsub("<SUF>", suf, structural_lines, fixed = TRUE))
  }
  pair_keys <- collect_pair_keys(pairs_list_k_flat)
  if (!is.null(pair_keys) && nrow(pair_keys) > 0) {
    for (r in seq_len(nrow(pair_keys))) {
      i <- pair_keys$i[r]; j <- pair_keys$j[r]; startval <- signif(pair_keys$cov[r], 4)
      suf1 <- paste0("_", i); suf2 <- paste0("_", j)
      lines <- c(lines, paste0("avg_pi", suf1, " ~~ start(", startval, ") * avg_pi", suf2))
    }
  } else {
    for (i in 1:(k-1)) lines <- c(lines, paste0("avg_pi_", i, " ~~ avg_pi_", i + 1))
  }
  if (length(derived_lines) > 0) lines <- c(lines, derived_lines)
  paste(lines, collapse = "\n")
}
```

#### Example

Check whitening approach to remove autocorrelation

```{r, evaluate-whitening, eval=T}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 0. Configuration
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
sel_chrs <- c(2L, 8L, 22L)
window_bp <- 1e4
max_block_span <- 1e6
vars_list <- list(
  avg_pi = c("B", "avg_mut", "avg_rec")
)
target_var <- "avg_pi"

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 1. Subset data
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
tbl_10kb <- filter(human_maps_10kb, constrained_model=="phastcons")  
tbl_10kb$avg_pi <- log(tbl_10kb$avg_pi)

# because of 0's
if(any(tbl_10kb$prop_del_sites==0)) {
  tbl_10kb$prop_del_sites <- log1p(tbl_10kb$prop_del_sites) 
} else {
  tbl_10kb$prop_del_sites <- log(tbl_10kb$prop_del_sites) 
}

tmp_B <- filter(B_10kb, constrained_model=="phastcons") %>%
         dplyr::select(., -constrained_model)

tbl_10kb <- left_join(tbl_10kb, tmp_B, by=c("chrom", 
                                            "chromStart", 
                                            "chromEnd"))

tbl_10kb <- left_join(tbl_10kb, rec_latent_10kb, by=c("chrom", 
                                                      "chromStart", 
                                                      "chromEnd"))

tbl_10kb <- left_join(tbl_10kb, mut_latent_10kb, by=c("chrom", 
                                                      "chromStart", 
                                                      "chromEnd"))

tbl_10kb <- filter(tbl_10kb, coverage >= 0.75)
names(tbl_10kb)[8:10] <- c("B", "avg_rec", "avg_mut")

# modeling autocorrelation
dt <- copy(tbl_10kb) %>%
       mutate(midpoint=(chromStart + chromEnd) / 2) %>%
       arrange(chrom, midpoint) %>%
       as.data.table()
setDT(dt)

stopifnot(all(c("chrom", "midpoint", target_var, vars_list[[target_var]]) %in% names(dt)))
dt_sub <- dt[chrom %in% sel_chrs]
setorderv(dt_sub, c("chrom", "midpoint"))
message("Windows after subset: ", nrow(dt_sub), " (chrom: ", paste(unique(dt_sub$chrom), collapse = ", "), ")")

# Run block specs
specs <- make_block_specs_robust(dt_sub, 
                                 vars = vars_list, 
                                 by_chr = "chrom", 
                                 window_bp = window_bp, 
                                 max_block_span = max_block_span)
block_map <- specs$block_map
decay_dt <- specs$decay_dt
message("Decay estimates produced for ", nrow(decay_dt), " chr-variable combos.")

# Print decay summary for target variable
print(decay_dt[variable == target_var])

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 2. Build sparse covariance blocks
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
sparse_obj <- make_sparse_cov_blocks(
  block_map = block_map,
  decay_dt = decay_dt,
  dt = dt_sub,
  by_chr = "chrom",
  max_pair_distance = 2e5,
  verbose = TRUE
)
message("Built sparse block covariance objects: ", length(sparse_obj$full_block_covs), " blocks.")

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 3. Prewhiten target variable (avg_pi) using prewhiten_all_variables wrapper
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# ensure prewhiten_all_variables is available (the wrapper you provided)
res_pw <- prewhiten_all_variables(dt_sub = dt_sub,
                                  vars = c(target_var),
                                  sparse_obj = sparse_obj,
                                  whiten_suffix = "_wh",
                                  assemble_cov = FALSE,
                                  parallel = FALSE,
                                  verbose = TRUE)
dt_whitened <- res_pw$dt_whitened
print(res_pw$diagnostics)

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 4. For each chromosome: fit OLS, compute residuals raw and whitened, compute ACFs
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
compute_resid_and_acf <- function(dt_chr, response, predictors, whitened_col = NULL, max_lag = 50) {
  fml <- as.formula(paste(response, "~", paste(predictors, collapse = " + ")))
  ols <- try(lm(fml, data = dt_chr), silent = TRUE)
  if (inherits(ols, "try-error")) return(NULL)
  resid_raw <- resid(ols)
  acf_raw <- if (length(resid_raw) >= 3) {
    acf_obj <- acf(resid_raw, plot = FALSE, lag.max = max_lag, na.action = na.pass)
    data.table(lag = as.integer(acf_obj$lag[,1,1]), acf = as.numeric(acf_obj$acf[,1,1]))
  } else data.table(lag = integer(0), acf = numeric(0))
  if (!is.null(whitened_col) && whitened_col %in% names(dt_chr)) {
    dt_chr2 <- copy(dt_chr); dt_chr2[, response := dt_chr2[[whitened_col]]]
    fml_w <- as.formula(paste("response ~", paste(predictors, collapse = " + ")))
    ols_w <- try(lm(fml_w, data = dt_chr2), silent = TRUE)
    if (inherits(ols_w, "try-error")) {
      resid_white <- rep(NA_real_, nrow(dt_chr2))
      acf_white <- data.table(lag = integer(0), acf = numeric(0))
    } else {
      resid_white <- resid(ols_w)
      acf_obj_w <- acf(resid_white, plot = FALSE, lag.max = max_lag, na.action = na.pass)
      acf_white <- data.table(lag = as.integer(acf_obj_w$lag[,1,1]), acf = as.numeric(acf_obj_w$acf[,1,1]))
    }
  } else {
    acf_white <- data.table(lag = integer(0), acf = numeric(0))
  }
  list(acf_raw = acf_raw, acf_white = acf_white, resid_raw = resid_raw)
}

# collect ACFs
acf_results <- list()
for (chr_val in sel_chrs) {
  dt_chr_raw <- dt_sub[chr == chr_val]
  dt_chr_wh <- dt_whitened[chrom == chr_val]
  # use whitened column name
  whitened_col <- paste0(target_var, "_wh")
  res_chr <- compute_resid_and_acf(dt_chr_raw, response = target_var, predictors = vars_list[[target_var]], whitened_col = whitened_col, max_lag = 50)
  if (is.null(res_chr)) next
  acf_raw <- res_chr$acf_raw; acf_raw[, `:=`(chrom = chr_val, type = "raw")]
  acf_white <- res_chr$acf_white; acf_white[, `:=`(chrom = chr_val, type = "whitened")]
  acf_results[[as.character(chr_val)]] <- rbind(acf_raw, acf_white)
  message("chrom ", chr_val, ": raw acf rows = ", nrow(acf_raw), " ; whitened acf rows = ", nrow(acf_white))
}

acf_dt <- rbindlist(acf_results, use.names = TRUE, fill = TRUE)
acf_dt[, lag := as.integer(lag)]

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 5. Plot ACFs side-by-side
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
p <- ggplot(acf_dt, aes(x = lag, y = acf, color = type)) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_point(size = 1) +
  facet_wrap(~ chrom, scales = "free_y") +
  scale_color_manual(values = c(raw = "firebrick", whitened = "steelblue")) +
  labs(x = "Lag (index)", y = "ACF", color = "", title = paste0("Residual ACF for ", target_var, " before and after whitening")) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
  theme(legend.position = "top")
print(p)

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 6. Numeric diagnostics: mean absolute ACF at lags 1:5 by chrom and type
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
summary_dt <- acf_dt[lag >= 1 & lag <= 5, .(mean_abs_acf = mean(abs(acf), na.rm = TRUE)), by = .(chrom, type)]
print(summary_dt)

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 7. Per-block and per-chromosome diagnostic plots for decay (optional)
#    Print examples for any chromosome where a fit was returned
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
for (chr_val in sel_chrs) {
  drow <- decay_dt[chrom == as.character(chr_val) & variable == target_var]
  if (nrow(drow) == 0) next
  method <- drow$method[1]
  alpha <- drow$alpha[1]; sigma2 <- drow$sigma2[1]
  message("Decay chrom ", chr_val, ": method=", method, " alpha=", signif(alpha,4), " sigma2=", signif(sigma2,4))
  # if binned object exists in estimate result, plot (the robust estimator returns 'binned' inside the list when run earlier,
  # but in this wrapper we lost that object. If you want plots, run estimate_decay_per_chr_robust() per chromosome manually and use plot_decay_diagnostics()).
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 8. Print prewhiten diagnostics
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
print(res_pw$diagnostics)
```

Fit SEM

```{r, example-run, eval=F, include=F, message=F, warning=F}

# inputs
window_bp <- 1e4
dt <- copy(table_10kb)
setDT(dt)
stopifnot(all(c("chr","midpoint") %in% names(dt)))

# Define predictor sets per variable for model_2
vars_model_2 <- list(
  avg_pi = c("B", "avg_mut", "prop_del_sites"),
  B = c("prop_del_sites", "avg_mut", "avg_rec"),
  avg_mut= c("avg_rec")
)

# Build block specs and estimate decay per variable per chromosome
spec2 <- make_block_specs(dt = dt, vars = vars_model_2, by_chr = "chr", window_bp = window_bp,
                          max_block_span = 1e6, max_pair_distance = 2e5, min_pairs = 20)

# spec2$block_map ; spec2$decay_dt
print(head(spec2$decay_dt))

# For a full run you may proceed chromosome-wise. For demonstration we'll create a manageable subset:
# take up to N_per_chr windows per chromosome to make subsequent linear algebra feasible
N_per_chr <- 300
dt_sub <- dt[, .SD[seq_len(min(.N, N_per_chr))], by = chr]
# remap block_map to dt_sub row indices by matching chr & midpoint
bm <- merge(spec2$block_map, dt_sub[, .(chr, midpoint, sub_row = .I)], by = c("chr", "midpoint"))
block_map_sub <- bm[, .(row_id = sub_row, chr, midpoint, block_id)]

# Build sparse covariance blocks using decay estimates (for dt_sub)
decay_dt2 <- spec2$decay_dt
sparse_obj <- make_sparse_cov_blocks(block_map = block_map_sub, decay_dt = decay_dt2, dt = dt_sub,
                                     by_chr = "chr", max_pair_distance = 2e5)

vars_to_whiten <- c("avg_pi", "B", "avg_mut", "avg_rec", "prop_del_sites", "pi_sim_tot")
# Only whiten variables present in dt_sub
vars_to_whiten <- intersect(vars_to_whiten, names(dt_sub))
whitened_list <- lapply(vars_to_whiten, function(v) prewhiten_variable_blockwise(v, dt_sub, sparse_obj))
names(whitened_list) <- vars_to_whiten

dt_whiten <- copy(dt_sub)
for (v in names(whitened_list)) { dt_whiten[, (v) := whitened_list[[v]]] }

# Keep complete cases for the variables used in the SEM
model_vars <- c("pi_sim_tot", "avg_mut", "B", "prop_del_sites", "avg_rec")
model_vars <- intersect(model_vars, names(dt_whiten))
dt_whiten_complete <- dt_whiten[complete.cases(dt_whiten[, ..model_vars])]

# Compute whitened sample covariance and sample size
window_mat <- as.matrix(dt_whiten_complete[, ..model_vars])
sample_cov_whiten <- cov(window_mat, use = "pairwise.complete.obs")
n_obs_whiten <- nrow(window_mat)

# Fit model_2 in lavaan using whitened sample covariance
model_2_lavaan <- '
  pi_sim_tot ~ start(0.25)*c1*avg_mut
  pi_sim_tot ~ start(0.5)*c2*B
  pi_sim_tot ~ start(-0.25)*c3*prop_del_sites
  B ~ start(-0.25)*c4*prop_del_sites
  B ~ start(-0.25)*c5*avg_mut
  B ~ start(0.25)*c6*avg_rec
  avg_mut ~ start(0.25)*c7*avg_rec
  avg_mut ~~ 0*prop_del_sites
  mu_B_pi := c1*c5
  rec_B_pi := c2*c6
  rec_mu_pi := c1*c7
  rec_mu_B_pi := c2*c5*c7
'
fit <- sem(model_2_lavaan, sample.cov = sample_cov_whiten, sample.nobs = n_obs_whiten,
           sample.mean = colMeans(dt_whiten_complete[, ..model_vars], na.rm = TRUE))
summary(fit, standardized = TRUE, fit.measures = TRUE)

```

```{r, fitting-SEM-DAGs, eval=F, include=F, message=F, warning=F}
# 10 kb
for(m in unique(human_maps_10kb$constrained_model)) { 

  print(paste(m, Sys.Date(), Sys.time()), sep="\t")
  cat(paste("10kb", m))
  cat("\n")
  
  tbl_10kb <- filter(human_maps_10kb, constrained_model==m)  
  tbl_10kb$avg_pi <- log(tbl_10kb$avg_pi)
  
  # because of 0's
  if(any(tbl_10kb$prop_del_sites==0)) {
    tbl_10kb$prop_del_sites <- log1p(tbl_10kb$prop_del_sites) 
  } else {
    tbl_10kb$prop_del_sites <- log(tbl_10kb$prop_del_sites) 
  }
  
  tmp_B <- filter(B_10kb, constrained_model==m) %>%
           dplyr::select(., -constrained_model)
  
  tbl_10kb <- left_join(tbl_10kb, tmp_B, by=c("chrom", 
                                              "chromStart", 
                                              "chromEnd"))
  
  tbl_10kb <- left_join(tbl_10kb, rec_latent_10kb, by=c("chrom", 
                                                        "chromStart", 
                                                        "chromEnd"))
  
  tbl_10kb <- left_join(tbl_10kb, mut_latent_10kb, by=c("chrom", 
                                                        "chromStart", 
                                                        "chromEnd"))
  
  tbl_10kb <- filter(tbl_10kb, coverage > 0.75)
  names(tbl_10kb)[8:10] <- c("B", "avg_rec", "avg_mut")
  
  # modeling autocorrelation
  tbl <- copy(tbl_10kb) %>%
         mutate(midpoint=(chromStart + chromEnd) / 2) %>%
         arrange(chrom, midpoint) %>%
         as.data.table()
  
  chrom_list <- split(tbl, by="chrom")
  decay_list <- pbmclapply(chrom_list,
                           estimate_decay_per_chrom,
                           mc.cores=n_cores)
  
  decay_dt <- tibble(chrom=names(decay_list),
                   alpha=map_dbl(decay_list, "alpha"),
                   sigma2=map_dbl(decay_list, "sigma2"))
  
  tbl_blocks <- tbl[, .SD, by=chrom] %>%
  group_by(chrom) %>%
  group_map(~ make_distance_blocks(as.data.table(.x), 1e+4)) %>%
  bind_rows() %>%
  as.data.table()
  
  # run for all blocks (parallel)
  blocks_dt <- split(tbl_blocks, by=c("chrom", "block_id"))
  block_specs <- mclapply(blocks_dt, make_block_specs,
                          decay_dt=decay_dt,
                          max_pair_distance=max_pair_distance,
                          rho_threshold=rho_threshold,
                          mc.cores=n_cores)

  # filter non-NULL and bind wide rows
  block_specs <- compact(block_specs)
  wide_rows <- map_dfr(block_specs, function(x) {
    # remove midpoint entries before model data
    x_copy <- x
    pairs <- x_copy$pairs; x_copy$pairs <- NULL
    as_tibble(x_copy)
  })
  # attach pairs list as attribute keyed by row
  pairs_list <- map(block_specs, "pairs")
  
  # genome-wide models
  chosen_k <- 10 # block size
  wide_blocks_k <- wide_rows %>% filter(n_in_block==chosen_k)
  # retrieve corresponding pairs_list in same order
  pairs_list_k <- pairs_list[map_lgl(block_specs, ~ .x$n_in_block==chosen_k)]

  model0_k <- build_model0_for_k(chosen_k, pairs_list_k)

  m0_gw <- sem(model0_k,
               data=wide_blocks_k,
               group="chrom",
               group.equal="regressions",
               estimator="ML")

  
  fwrite(rbind.data.frame(names(unlist(inspect(m0_gw, "r2"))),
                          as.numeric(unlist(inspect(m0_gw, "r2")))), 
         paste("real_data_maps/lavaan_out/YRI_DAG0_r2_10kb_genomewide_", 
               "latents_", m, ".csv", sep=""),
         col.names=F)
  
  fwrite(parameterestimates(m0_gw, ci=T), 
         paste("real_data_maps/lavaan_out/YRI_DAG0_paqrams_10kb_genomewide_", 
               "latents_", m, ".csv", sep=""))
  
  fwrite(rbind.data.frame(names(fitMeasures(m0_gw)),
                          as.numeric(fitMeasures(m0_gw))), 
         paste("real_data_maps/lavaan_out/YRI_DAG0_fitmeasures_10kb_genomewide_", 
               "latents_", m, ".csv", sep=""),
         col.names=F)
  
  model1_k <- build_model1_for_k(chosen_k, pairs_list_k)
  
  m1gls <- sem(model1_k,
               data=tbl_10kb,
               fixed.x=F,
               std.ov=T,
               std.lv=T,
               group="chrom",
               group.equal="regressions",
               estimator="ML")
  
  fwrite(rbind.data.frame(names(unlist(inspect(m1gls, "r2"))),
                          as.numeric(unlist(inspect(m1gls, "r2")))), 
         paste("real_data_maps/lavaan_out/YRI_DAG1_r2_10kb_genomewide_", 
               "latents_", m, ".csv", sep=""),
         col.names=F)
  
  fwrite(parameterestimates(m1gls, ci=T), 
         paste("real_data_maps/lavaan_out/YRI_DAG1_params_10kb_genomewide_", 
               "latents_", m, ".csv", sep=""))
  
  fwrite(rbind.data.frame(names(fitMeasures(m1gls)),
                          as.numeric(fitMeasures(m1gls))), 
         paste("real_data_maps/lavaan_out/YRI_DAG1_fitmeasures_10kb_genomewide_", 
               "latents_", m, ".csv", sep=""),
         col.names=F)
  
  m2gls <- sem(model_2,
               data=tbl_10kb,
               fixed.x=F,
               std.ov=T,
               std.lv=T,
               group="chrom",
               group.equal="regressions",
               estimator="GLS")
  
  fwrite(rbind.data.frame(names(unlist(inspect(m2gls, "r2"))),

  fwrite(rbind.data.frame(names(unlist(inspect(m2gls_free, "r2"))),
                          as.numeric(unlist(inspect(m2gls_free, "r2")))), 
         paste("real_data_maps/lavaan_out/YRI_DAG2_r2_10kb_genomewide_",

  fwrite(parameterestimates(m2gls_free, ci=T),

               "latents_", m, "_freechrom.csv", sep=""))
  
  fwrite(rbind.data.frame(names(fitMeasures(m2gls_free)),
                          as.numeric(fitMeasures(m2gls_free))), 
         paste("real_data_maps/lavaan_out/YRI_DAG2_fitmeasures_10kb_genomewide_", 
               "latents_", m, "_freechrom.csv", sep=""),
         col.names=F)
  
  fwrite(lavTestLRT(m2gls, m2gls_free),
         paste("real_data_maps/lavaan_out/LRT_DAG2_gw-equal-freechrom_10kb_", 
               "latents_", m, ".csv", sep=""))
  
  
  model_3 <- "
  avg_pi ~ start(0.25)*c1*avg_mut
  avg_pi ~ start(0.5)*c2*B
  avg_pi ~ start(-0.25)*c3*prop_del_sites
  B ~ start(-0.25)*c4*prop_del_sites
  B ~ start(-0.25)*c5*avg_mut
  B ~ start(0.25)*c6*avg_rec
  avg_mut ~ start(0.25)*c7*avg_rec
  avg_mut ~~ prop_del_sites
  mu_B_pi:=c1*c5
  rec_B_pi:=c2*c6
  rec_mu_pi:=c1*c7
  rec_mu_B_pi:=c2*c5*c7
  "
  
  m3gls <- sem(model_3,
               data=tbl_10kb,
               fixed.x=F,
               std.ov=T,
               std.lv=T,
               group="chrom",
               group.equal="regressions",
               estimator="GLS")
  
  fwrite(rbind.data.frame(names(unlist(inspect(m3gls, "r2"))),
                          as.numeric(unlist(inspect(m3gls, "r2")))), 
         paste("real_data_maps/lavaan_out/YRI_DAG3_r2_10kb_genomewide_",

  fwrite(parameterestimates(m3gls, ci=T),

         col.names=F)
  
  fwrite(lavTestLRT(m2gls, m3gls),
         paste("real_data_maps/lavaan_out/LRT_DAG2_DAG3_10kb_genomewide_",

  model_3_free <- "
  avg_pi ~ c(x1, x2, x3, x4, x5, x6, x7, x8, x9, x10, x11, x12, x13, x14, x15, x16, x17, x18, x19, x20, x21, x22)*avg_mut
  avg_pi ~ c(y1, y2, y3, y4, y5, y6, y7, y8, y9, y10, y11, y12, y13, y14, y15, y16, y17, y18, y19, y20, y21, y22)*B
  avg_pi ~ start(-0.25)*c3*prop_del_sites
  B ~ start(-0.25)*c4*prop_del_sites
  B ~ start(-0.25)*c5*avg_mut
  B ~ start(0.25)*c6*avg_rec
  avg_mut ~ start(0.25)*c7*avg_rec
  avg_mut ~~ prop_del_sites
  mu_B_pi:=c(x1, x2, x3, x4, x5, x6, x7, x8, x9, x10, x11, x12, x13, x14, x15, x16, x17, x18, x19, x20, x21, x22)*c5
  rec_B_pi:=c(y1, y2, y3, y4, y5, y6, y7, y8, y9, y10, y11, y12, y13, y14, y15, y16, y17, y18, y19, y20, y21, y22)*c6
  rec_mu_pi:=c(y1, y2, y3, y4, y5, y6, y7, y8, y9, y10, y11, y12, y13, y14, y15, y16, y17, y18, y19, y20, y21, y22)*c7
  rec_mu_B_pi:=c(y1, y2, y3, y4, y5, y6, y7, y8, y9, y10, y11, y12, y13, y14, y15, y16, y17, y18, y19, y20, y21, y22)*c5*c7
  "
  
  m3gls_free <- sem(model_3_free,
                    data=tbl_10kb,
                    fixed.x=F,
                    std.ov=T,
                    std.lv=T,
                    group="chrom",
                    group.equal="none",
                    estimator="GLS")
  
  fwrite(rbind.data.frame(names(unlist(inspect(m3gls_free, "r2"))),
                          as.numeric(unlist(inspect(m3gls_free, "r2")))),

               "latents_", m, "_freechrom.csv", sep=""),

  fwrite(parameterestimates(m3gls_free, ci=T), 
         paste("real_data_maps/lavaan_out/YRI_DAG3_params_10kb_genomewide_", 
               "latents_", m, "_freechrom.csv", sep=""))
  
  fwrite(rbind.data.frame(names(fitMeasures(m3gls_free)),
                          as.numeric(fitMeasures(m3gls_free))),

  fwrite(lavTestLRT(m3gls, m3gls_free),
         paste("real_data_maps/lavaan_out/LRT_DAG3_gw-equal-freechrom_10kb_",

  fwrite(lavTestLRT(m2gls_free, m3gls_free),
         paste("real_data_maps/lavaan_out/LRT_DAG2_DAG3_freechrom_10kb_genomewide_", 
               "latents_", m, ".csv", sep=""))

  m3boot <- sem(model_3,
                data=tbl_10kb, 
                fixed.x=F,
                std.ov=T,
                std.lv=T,
                estimator="ML",

                group.equal="regressions",

                          as.numeric(fitMeasures(m3boot))), 
         paste("real_data_maps/lavaan_out/YRI_DAG3_fitmeasures_10kb_genomewide", 
               "_latents_", m, "_BOOT.csv", sep=""),
         col.names=F)
  
  fwrite(lavTestLRT(m2boot, m3boot),
           paste("real_data_maps/lavaan_out/LRT_DAG2_DAG3_10kb_genomewide",
                 "_latents_", m, "_BOOT.csv", sep=""))
    
  # one model per chrom
  for(c in 1:22) {
  
    model_0 <- "
    avg_pi ~ start(0.25)*c1*avg_mut
    avg_pi ~ start(0.5)*c2*B

           paste("real_data_maps/lavaan_out/YRI_DAG0_params_10kb_chr", 
                 c, "_latents_", m, ".csv", sep=""))
    
    model_1 <- "
    avg_pi ~ start(0.25)*c1*avg_mut
    avg_pi ~ start(0.5)*c2*B
    avg_pi ~ start(-0.25)*c3*prop_del_sites
    B ~ start(-0.25)*c4*prop_del_sites
    B ~ start(-0.25)*c5*avg_mut
    mu_B_pi:=c1*c5
    "
    
    m1gls <- sem(model_1,
                 data=filter(tbl_10kb, chrom==c),
                 fixed.x=F,
                 std.ov=T,
                 std.lv=T,
                 estimator="GLS")
    
    fwrite(rbind.data.frame(names(inspect(m1gls, "r2")),
                            as.numeric(inspect(m1gls, "r2"))),

    fwrite(parameterestimates(m1gls, ci=T), 
           paste("real_data_maps/lavaan_out/YRI_DAG1_params_10kb_chr", 
                 c, "_latents_", m, ".csv", sep=""))
    
    model_2 <- "
    avg_pi ~ start(0.25)*c1*avg_mut
    avg_pi ~ start(0.5)*c2*B
    avg_pi ~ start(-0.25)*c3*prop_del_sites
    B ~ start(-0.25)*c4*prop_del_sites
    B ~ start(-0.25)*c5*avg_mut
    B ~ start(0.25)*c6*avg_rec
    avg_mut ~ start(0.25)*c7*avg_rec
    avg_mut ~~ 0*prop_del_sites
    mu_B_pi:=c1*c5
    rec_B_pi:=c2*c6
    rec_mu_pi:=c1*c7
    rec_mu_B_pi:=c2*c5*c7
    "
    
    m2gls <- sem(model_2,

    fwrite(rbind.data.frame(names(inspect(m2gls, "r2")),

                 c, "_latents_", m, ".csv", sep=""),

    m2boot <- sem(model_2,

                  std.lv=T,
                  estimator="ML",
                  test="boot",
                  se="boot")
    
    fwrite(rbind.data.frame(names(inspect(m2boot, "r2")),
                            as.numeric(inspect(m2boot, "r2"))), 
           paste("real_data_maps/lavaan_out/YRI_DAG2_r2_10kb_chr", 
                 c, "_latents_", m, "_BOOT.csv", sep=""),
           col.names=F)
  
    fwrite(parameterEstimates(m2boot, ci=F), 
           paste("real_data_maps/lavaan_out/YRI_DAG2_params_10kb_chr", 
                 c, "_latents_", m, "_BOOT.csv", sep=""))
    
    fwrite(rbind.data.frame(names(fitMeasures(m2boot)),
                            as.numeric(fitMeasures(m2boot))), 
           paste("real_data_maps/lavaan_out/YRI_DAG2_fitmeasures_10kb_chr",

           col.names=F)
    
    model_3 <- "
    avg_pi ~ start(0.25)*c1*avg_mut
    avg_pi ~ start(0.5)*c2*B
    avg_pi ~ start(-0.25)*c3*prop_del_sites
    B ~ start(-0.25)*c4*prop_del_sites
    B ~ start(-0.25)*c5*avg_mut
    B ~ start(0.25)*c6*avg_rec
    avg_mut ~ start(0.25)*c7*avg_rec
    avg_mut ~~ prop_del_sites
    mu_B_pi:=c1*c5
    rec_B_pi:=c2*c6
    rec_mu_pi:=c1*c7
    rec_mu_B_pi:=c2*c5*c7
    "
    
    m3gls <- sem(model_3,
                 data=filter(tbl_10kb, chrom==c),

                 std.ov=T,
                 std.lv=T,

                 c, "_latents_", m, ".csv", sep=""),

    fwrite(parameterestimates(m3gls, ci=T),

    fwrite(rbind.data.frame(names(fitMeasures(m3gls)),
                            as.numeric(fitMeasures(m3gls))),

                 c, "_latents_", m, ".csv", sep=""),

    fwrite(lavTestLRT(m2gls, m3gls),
           paste("real_data_maps/lavaan_out/LRT_DAG2_DAG3_10kb_chr",

    m3boot <- sem(model_3,
                  data=filter(tbl_10kb, chrom==c),

                  test="boot",

    fwrite(rbind.data.frame(names(inspect(m3boot, "r2")),

    fwrite(parameterEstimates(m3boot, ci=F),

    fwrite(lavTestLRT(m2boot, m3boot),
           paste("real_data_maps/lavaan_out/LRT_DAG2_DAG3_10kb_chr",
                 c, "_latents_", m, "_BOOT.csv", sep=""))
  }
}

# 100 kb

  fwrite(parameterestimates(m0boot, ci=F),

  fwrite(rbind.data.frame(names(fitMeasures(m0boot)),
                          as.numeric(fitMeasures(m0boot))),

  model_1 <- "

  B ~ start(-0.25)*c4*prop_del_sites
  B ~ start(-0.25)*c5*avg_mut

  "
  
  m1gls <- sem(model_1,
               data=tbl_100kb,
               fixed.x=F,

# 1 Mb
for(m in unique(human_maps_1Mb$constrained_model)) { 

  print(paste(m, Sys.Date(), Sys.time()), sep="\t")
  cat(paste("1Mb", m))
  cat("\n")
  
  tbl_1Mb <- filter(human_maps_1Mb, constrained_model==m)  
  tbl_1Mb$avg_pi <- log(tbl_1Mb$avg_pi)
  
  # because of 0's
  if(any(tbl_1Mb$prop_del_sites==0)) {
    tbl_1Mb$prop_del_sites <- log1p(tbl_1Mb$prop_del_sites) 
  } else {
    tbl_1Mb$prop_del_sites <- log(tbl_1Mb$prop_del_sites) 
  }
  
  tmp_B <- filter(B_1Mb, constrained_model==m) %>%
           dplyr::select(., -constrained_model)
  
  tbl_1Mb <- left_join(tbl_1Mb, tmp_B, by=c("chrom", 
                                              "chromStart", 
                                              "chromEnd"))
  
  tbl_1Mb <- left_join(tbl_1Mb, rec_latent_1Mb, by=c("chrom", 
                                                        "chromStart", 
                                                        "chromEnd"))
  
  tbl_1Mb <- left_join(tbl_1Mb, mut_latent_1Mb, by=c("chrom", 
                                                        "chromStart", 
                                                        "chromEnd"))

    fwrite(rbind.data.frame(names(fitMeasures(m3gls)),
                            as.numeric(fitMeasures(m3gls))), 
           paste("real_data_maps/lavaan_out/YRI_DAG3_fitmeasures_1Mb_chr", 
                 c, "_latents_", m, ".csv", sep=""),
           col.names=F)
    
    fwrite(lavTestLRT(m2gls, m3gls),
           paste("real_data_maps/lavaan_out/LRT_DAG2_DAG3_1Mb_chr",
                 c, "_latents_", m, ".csv", sep=""))
    
    m3boot <- sem(model_3,
                  data=filter(tbl_1Mb, chrom==c),
                  fixed.x=F,
                  std.ov=T,
                  std.lv=T,
                  estimator="ML",
                  test="boot",
                  se="boot")
    
    fwrite(rbind.data.frame(names(inspect(m3boot, "r2")),
                            as.numeric(inspect(m3boot, "r2"))), 
           paste("real_data_maps/lavaan_out/YRI_DAG3_r2_1Mb_chr", 
                 c, "_latents_", m, "_BOOT.csv", sep=""),
           col.names=F)
  
    fwrite(parameterEstimates(m3boot, ci=F), 
           paste("real_data_maps/lavaan_out/YRI_DAG3_params_1Mb_chr", 
                 c, "_latents_", m, "_BOOT.csv", sep=""))
    
    fwrite(rbind.data.frame(names(fitMeasures(m3boot)),
                            as.numeric(fitMeasures(m3boot))), 
           paste("real_data_maps/lavaan_out/YRI_DAG3_fitmeasures_1Mb_chr", 
                 c, "_latents_", m, "_BOOT.csv", sep=""),
           col.names=F)
    
    fwrite(lavTestLRT(m2boot, m3boot),
           paste("real_data_maps/lavaan_out/LRT_DAG2_DAG3_1Mb_chr",
                 c, "_latents_", m, "_BOOT.csv", sep=""))
  }
}
```

```{r SEM-human-fitmeasures, eval=F, include=F, message=F, warning=F}
## 10 kb
chr_fitmeasures_10kb_gls <- data.frame()
chr_fitmeasures_10kb_boot <- data.frame()
for(dag in 2:3) {
  for(m in unique(human_maps_10kb$constrained_model)) { 
    chr_list_gls <- list(length=22)
    chr_list_boot <- list(length=22)
    for(c in 1:22) {
      
      tmp <- fread(paste("real_data_maps/lavaan_out/YRI_DAG", dag,
                         "_fitmeasures_10kb_chr", 
                         c, "_latents_", m, ".csv", sep=""))
      
      tmp$chrom <- c
      tmp$DAG <- dag
      tmp$constrained_model <- m
      tmp$method <- "GLS"
      
      chr_list_gls[[c]] <- tmp
      
      tmp <- fread(paste("real_data_maps/lavaan_out/YRI_DAG", dag, 
                         "_fitmeasures_10kb_chr", 
                         c, "_latents_", m, "_BOOT.csv", sep=""))
      
      tmp$chrom <- c
      tmp$DAG <- dag
      tmp$constrained_model <- m
      tmp$method <- "BOOT"
      
      chr_list_boot[[c]] <- tmp
    }
    
    df <- do.call(rbind.data.frame, chr_list_gls)
    chr_fitmeasures_10kb_gls <- rbind.data.frame(chr_fitmeasures_10kb_gls, df)
    
    df <- do.call(rbind.data.frame, chr_list_boot)
    chr_fitmeasures_10kb_boot <- rbind.data.frame(chr_fitmeasures_10kb_boot, df)
  }
}

}

    tmp <- as.data.frame(tmp$`Pr(>Chisq)`[2],)  
    tmp$chrom <- c
    tmp$constrained_model <- m
    tmp$method <- "BOOT"
    
    chr_list_boot[[c]] <- tmp
  }
  
  df <- do.call(rbind.data.frame, chr_list_gls)

  df <- do.call(rbind.data.frame, chr_list_boot)
  chr_LRT_10kb_boot <- rbind.data.frame(chr_LRT_10kb_boot, df)
}
```

## Path Models with simulated pi

Here we use simulated pi (mutational variance)

10 kb

```{r SEM-human-maps-10kb, eval=F, include=F, message=F, warning=F}

human_maps_10kb <- fread("real_data_maps/maps_10kb_models.csv.gz") %>%
                   filter(., mut_map!="uniform") %>%
                   dplyr::select(-c(bin_100kb, bin_1Mb))
  
for(u in unique(human_maps_10kb$mut_map)) {
  Sys.time()
  
  cat(paste("fitting SEM(s) -- ", u, sep=""))
  cat("\n")

  for(m in unique(human_maps_10kb$constrained_model)) { 
    for(d in unique(human_maps_10kb$demo)) {
      
      tbl_10kb <- filter(human_maps_10kb,
                         coverage > 0.75,
                         mut_map==u,
                         constrained_model==m,
                         demo==d) %>%
                         dplyr::select(., -starts_with("bin_")) 
      
      tbl_10kb_log <- cbind.data.frame(tbl_10kb[,1:3],
                        apply(tbl_10kb[,4:(ncol(tbl_10kb)-4)], 2, log))
      
      # because of 0's
      if(any(tbl_10kb$prop_del_sites==0)) {
        tbl_10kb_log$prop_del_sites <- log1p(tbl_10kb$prop_del_sites) 
      } else {
        tbl_10kb_log$prop_del_sites <- log(tbl_10kb$prop_del_sites) 
      }
      
      # genome-wide models
      model_0 <- "
      pi_sim_tot ~ start(0.25)*c1*avg_mut
      pi_sim_tot ~ start(0.5)*c2*B
      B ~ start(-0.25)*c3*avg_mut
      "
      
      m0gls <- sem(model_0,
                   data=tbl_10kb_log,
                   fixed.x=F,
                   std.ov=T,
                   std.lv=T,
                   group="chrom",
                   estimator="GLS")
      
      fwrite(rbind.data.frame(names(unlist(inspect(m0gls, "r2"))),
                              as.numeric(unlist(inspect(m0gls, "r2")))), 
             paste("real_data_maps/lavaan_out/simpi_DAG0_r2_10kb_genomewide_", 
                   d, "_", m, "_", u, ".csv", sep=""),
             col.names=F)
  
      fwrite(parameterestimates(m0gls, ci=T), 
             paste("real_data_maps/lavaan_out/simpi_DAG0_params_10kb_genomewide_", 
                   d, "_", m, "_", u, ".csv", sep=""))
      
      fwrite(rbind.data.frame(names(fitMeasures(m0gls)),
                              as.numeric(fitMeasures(m0gls))), 
             paste("real_data_maps/lavaan_out/simpi_DAG0_fitmeasures_10kb_genomewide_", 
                   d, "_", m, "_", u, ".csv", sep=""),
             col.names=F)
      
      model_1 <- "
      pi_sim_tot ~ start(0.25)*c1*avg_mut
      pi_sim_tot ~ start(0.5)*c2*B
      pi_sim_tot ~ start(-0.25)*c3*prop_del_sites
      B ~ start(-0.25)*c4*prop_del_sites
      B ~ start(-0.25)*c5*avg_mut
      mu_B_pi:=c1*c5
      "
      
      m1gls <- sem(model_1,
                   data=tbl_10kb_log,
                   fixed.x=F,
                   std.ov=T,
                   std.lv=T,
                   group="chrom",
                   estimator="GLS")
      
      fwrite(rbind.data.frame(names(unlist(inspect(m1gls, "r2"))),
                              as.numeric(unlist(inspect(m1gls, "r2")))), 
             paste("real_data_maps/lavaan_out/simpi_DAG1_r2_10kb_genomewide_", 
                   d, "_", m, "_", u, ".csv", sep=""),
             col.names=F)
  
      fwrite(parameterestimates(m1gls, ci=T), 
             paste("real_data_maps/lavaan_out/simpi_DAG1_params_10kb_genomewide_", 
                   d, "_", m, "_", u, ".csv", sep=""))
      
      fwrite(rbind.data.frame(names(fitMeasures(m1gls)),
                              as.numeric(fitMeasures(m1gls))), 
             paste("real_data_maps/lavaan_out/simpi_DAG1_fitmeasures_10kb_genomewide_", 
                   d, "_", m, "_", u, ".csv", sep=""),
             col.names=F)
      
      model_2 <- "
      pi_sim_tot ~ start(0.25)*c1*avg_mut
      pi_sim_tot ~ start(0.5)*c2*B
      pi_sim_tot ~ start(-0.25)*c3*prop_del_sites
      B ~ start(-0.25)*c4*prop_del_sites
      B ~ start(-0.25)*c5*avg_mut
      B ~ start(0.25)*c6*avg_rec
      avg_mut ~ start(0.25)*c7*avg_rec
      avg_mut ~~ 0*prop_del_sites
      mu_B_pi:=c1*c5
      rec_B_pi:=c2*c6
      rec_mu_pi:=c1*c7
      rec_mu_B_pi:=c2*c5*c7
      "
      
      m2gls <- sem(model_2,
                   data=tbl_10kb_log,
                   fixed.x=F,
                   std.ov=T,
                   std.lv=T,
                   group="chrom",
                   estimator="GLS")
      
      fwrite(rbind.data.frame(names(unlist(inspect(m2gls, "r2"))),
                              as.numeric(unlist(inspect(m2gls, "r2")))), 
             paste("real_data_maps/lavaan_out/simpi_DAG2_r2_10kb_genomewide_", 
                   d, "_", m, "_", u, ".csv", sep=""),
             col.names=F)
  
      fwrite(parameterestimates(m2gls, ci=T), 
             paste("real_data_maps/lavaan_out/simpi_DAG2_params_10kb_genomewide_", 
                   d, "_", m, "_", u, ".csv", sep=""))
      
      fwrite(rbind.data.frame(names(fitMeasures(m2gls)),
                              as.numeric(fitMeasures(m2gls))), 
             paste("real_data_maps/lavaan_out/simpi_DAG2_fitmeasures_10kb_genomewide_", 
                   d, "_", m, "_", u, ".csv", sep=""),
             col.names=F)
      
      model_3 <- "
      pi_sim_tot ~ start(0.25)*c1*avg_mut
      pi_sim_tot ~ start(0.5)*c2*B
      pi_sim_tot ~ start(-0.25)*c3*prop_del_sites
      B ~ start(-0.25)*c4*prop_del_sites
      B ~ start(-0.25)*c5*avg_mut
      B ~ start(0.25)*c6*avg_rec
      avg_mut ~ start(0.25)*c7*avg_rec
      avg_mut ~~ prop_del_sites
      mu_B_pi:=c1*c5
      rec_B_pi:=c2*c6
      rec_mu_pi:=c1*c7
      rec_mu_B_pi:=c2*c5*c7
      "
      
      m3gls <- sem(model_3,
                   data=tbl_10kb_log,
                   fixed.x=F,
                   std.ov=T,
                   std.lv=T,
                   group="chrom",
                   estimator="GLS")
      
      fwrite(rbind.data.frame(names(unlist(inspect(m3gls, "r2"))),
                              as.numeric(unlist(inspect(m3gls, "r2")))), 
             paste("real_data_maps/lavaan_out/simpi_DAG3_r2_10kb_genomewide_", 
                   d, "_", m, "_", u, ".csv", sep=""),
             col.names=F)
  
      fwrite(parameterestimates(m3gls, ci=T), 
          paste("real_data_maps/lavaan_out/simpi_DAG3_params_10kb_genomewide_", 
                d, "_", m, "_", u, ".csv", sep=""))
      
      fwrite(rbind.data.frame(names(fitMeasures(m3gls)),
                              as.numeric(fitMeasures(m3gls))), 
             paste("real_data_maps/lavaan_out/simpi_DAG3_fitmeasures_10kb_genomewide_", 
                   d, "_", m, "_", u, ".csv", sep=""),
             col.names=F)
      
      fwrite(lavTestLRT(m2gls, m3gls),
             paste("real_data_maps/lavaan_out/LRT_DAG2_DAG3_10kb_genomewide_",
                   d, "_", m, "_", u, ".csv", sep=""))
        
      # one model per chrom
      for(c in 1:22) {
    
        model_0 <- "
        pi_sim_tot ~ start(0.25)*c1*avg_mut
        pi_sim_tot ~ start(0.5)*c2*B
        B ~ start(-0.25)*c3*avg_mut
        "
        
        m0gls <- sem(model_0,
                   data=filter(tbl_10kb_log, chrom==c),
                   fixed.x=F,
                   std.ov=T,
                   std.lv=T,
                   estimator="GLS")
        
        fwrite(rbind.data.frame(names(inspect(m0gls, "r2")),
                                as.numeric(inspect(m0gls, "r2"))), 
               paste("real_data_maps/lavaan_out/simpi_DAG0_r2_10kb_chr", 
                     c, "_", d, "_", m, "_", u, ".csv", sep=""),
               col.names=F)
    
        fwrite(parameterestimates(m0gls, ci=T), 
               paste("real_data_maps/lavaan_out/simpi_DAG0_params_10kb_chr", 
                     c, "_", d, "_", m, "_", u, ".csv", sep=""))
        
        model_1 <- "
        pi_sim_tot ~ start(0.25)*c1*avg_mut
        pi_sim_tot ~ start(0.5)*c2*B
        pi_sim_tot ~ start(-0.25)*c3*prop_del_sites
        B ~ start(-0.25)*c4*prop_del_sites
        B ~ start(-0.25)*c5*avg_mut
        mu_B_pi:=c1*c5
        "
        
        m1gls <- sem(model_1,
                     data=filter(tbl_10kb_log, chrom==c),
                     fixed.x=F,
                     std.ov=T,
                     std.lv=T,
                     estimator="GLS")
        
        fwrite(rbind.data.frame(names(inspect(m1gls, "r2")),
                                as.numeric(inspect(m1gls, "r2"))), 
               paste("real_data_maps/lavaan_out/simpi_DAG1_r2_10kb_chr",

               col.names=F)
    
        fwrite(parameterestimates(m1gls, ci=T),

                     c, "_", d, "_", m, "_", u, ".csv", sep=""))
        
        model_2 <- "
        pi_sim_tot ~ start(0.25)*c1*avg_mut
        pi_sim_tot ~ start(0.5)*c2*B
        pi_sim_tot ~ start(-0.25)*c3*prop_del_sites
        B ~ start(-0.25)*c4*prop_del_sites
        B ~ start(-0.25)*c5*avg_mut
        B ~ start(0.25)*c6*avg_rec
```

```{r SEM-human-maps-100kb, eval=F, include=F, message=F, warning=F}
for(u in unique(human_maps_100kb$mut_map)) {
  Sys.time()

  cat("\n")

                        apply(tbl_100kb[,4:(ncol(tbl_100kb)-4)], 2, log))

        tbl_100kb_log$prop_del_sites <- log1p(tbl_100kb$prop_del_sites)

        tbl_100kb_log$prop_del_sites <- log(tbl_100kb$prop_del_sites)

                   std.lv=T,
```

```{r SEM-human-maps-1Mb, eval=F, include=F, message=F, warning=F}
      fwrite(rbind.data.frame(names(fitMeasures(m3gls)),
                              as.numeric(fitMeasures(m3gls))), 
             paste("real_data_maps/lavaan_out/simpi_DAG3_fitmeasures_1Mb_genomewide_", 
                   d, "_", m, "_", u, ".csv", sep=""),
             col.names=F)
      
      fwrite(lavTestLRT(m2gls, m3gls),
             paste("real_data_maps/lavaan_out/LRT_DAG2_DAG3_1Mb_genomewide_", 
                   d, "_", m, "_", u, ".csv", sep=""))
        
      # one model per chrom
      for(c in 1:22) {
    
        model_0 <- "
        pi_sim_tot ~ start(0.25)*c1*avg_mut
        pi_sim_tot ~ start(0.5)*c2*B
        B ~ start(-0.25)*c3*avg_mut
        "
        
        m0gls <- sem(model_0,
                   data=filter(tbl_1Mb_log, chrom==c),
                   fixed.x=F,
                   std.ov=T,
                   std.lv=T,
                   estimator="GLS")
        
        fwrite(rbind.data.frame(names(inspect(m0gls, "r2")),
                                as.numeric(inspect(m0gls, "r2"))), 
               paste("real_data_maps/lavaan_out/simpi_DAG0_r2_1Mb_chr", 
                     c, "_", d, "_", m, "_", u, ".csv", sep=""),
               col.names=F)
    
        fwrite(parameterestimates(m0gls, ci=T), 
               paste("real_data_maps/lavaan_out/simpi_DAG0_params_1Mb_chr", 
                     c, "_", d, "_", m, "_", u, ".csv", sep=""))
        
        model_1 <- "
        pi_sim_tot ~ start(0.25)*c1*avg_mut
        pi_sim_tot ~ start(0.5)*c2*B
        pi_sim_tot ~ start(-0.25)*c3*prop_del_sites
        B ~ start(-0.25)*c4*prop_del_sites
        B ~ start(-0.25)*c5*avg_mut
        mu_B_pi:=c1*c5
        "
        
        m1gls <- sem(model_1,
                     data=filter(tbl_1Mb_log, chrom==c),
                     fixed.x=F,
                     std.ov=T,
                     std.lv=T,
                     estimator="GLS")
        
        fwrite(rbind.data.frame(names(inspect(m1gls, "r2")),
                                as.numeric(inspect(m1gls, "r2"))), 
               paste("real_data_maps/lavaan_out/simpi_DAG1_r2_1Mb_chr", 
                     c, "_", d, "_", m, "_", u, ".csv", sep=""),
               col.names=F)
    
        fwrite(parameterestimates(m1gls, ci=T), 
               paste("real_data_maps/lavaan_out/simpi_DAG1_params_1Mb_chr", 
                     c, "_", d, "_", m, "_", u, ".csv", sep=""))
        
        model_2 <- "
        pi_sim_tot ~ start(0.25)*c1*avg_mut
        pi_sim_tot ~ start(0.5)*c2*B
        pi_sim_tot ~ start(-0.25)*c3*prop_del_sites
        B ~ start(-0.25)*c4*prop_del_sites
        B ~ start(-0.25)*c5*avg_mut
        B ~ start(0.25)*c6*avg_rec
        avg_mut ~ start(0.25)*c7*avg_rec
        avg_mut ~~ 0*prop_del_sites
        mu_B_pi:=c1*c5
        rec_B_pi:=c2*c6
        rec_mu_pi:=c1*c7
        rec_mu_B_pi:=c2*c5*c7
        "
        
        m2gls <- sem(model_2,
                     data=filter(tbl_1Mb_log, chrom==c),
                     fixed.x=F,
                     std.ov=T,
                     std.lv=T,
                     estimator="GLS")
        
        fwrite(rbind.data.frame(names(inspect(m2gls, "r2")),
                                as.numeric(inspect(m2gls, "r2"))), 
               paste("real_data_maps/lavaan_out/simpi_DAG2_r2_1Mb_chr", 
                     c, "_", d, "_", m, "_", u, ".csv", sep=""),
               col.names=F)
    
        fwrite(parameterestimates(m2gls, ci=T), 
               paste("real_data_maps/lavaan_out/simpi_DAG2_params_1Mb_chr", 
                     c, "_", d, "_", m, "_", u, ".csv", sep=""))
        
        fwrite(rbind.data.frame(names(fitMeasures(m2gls)),
                                as.numeric(fitMeasures(m2gls))), 
               paste("real_data_maps/lavaan_out/simpi_DAG2_fitmeasures_1Mb_chr", 
                     c, "_", d, "_", m, "_", u, ".csv", sep=""),
               col.names=F)
        
        model_3 <- "
        pi_sim_tot ~ start(0.25)*c1*avg_mut
        pi_sim_tot ~ start(0.5)*c2*B
        pi_sim_tot ~ start(-0.25)*c3*prop_del_sites
        B ~ start(-0.25)*c4*prop_del_sites
        B ~ start(-0.25)*c5*avg_mut
        B ~ start(0.25)*c6*avg_rec
        avg_mut ~ start(0.25)*c7*avg_rec
        avg_mut ~~ prop_del_sites
        mu_B_pi:=c1*c5
        rec_B_pi:=c2*c6
        rec_mu_pi:=c1*c7
        rec_mu_B_pi:=c2*c5*c7
        "
        
        m3gls <- sem(model_3,
                     data=filter(tbl_1Mb_log, chrom==c),
                     fixed.x=F,
                     std.ov=T,
                     std.lv=T,
                     estimator="GLS")
        
        fwrite(rbind.data.frame(names(inspect(m3gls, "r2")),
                                as.numeric(inspect(m3gls, "r2"))), 
               paste("real_data_maps/lavaan_out/simpi_DAG3_r2_1Mb_chr", 
                     c, "_", d, "_", m, "_", u, ".csv", sep=""),
               col.names=F)
    
        fwrite(parameterestimates(m3gls, ci=T), 
               paste("real_data_maps/lavaan_out/simpi_DAG3_params_1Mb_chr", 
                     c, "_", d, "_", m, "_", u, ".csv", sep=""))
        
        fwrite(rbind.data.frame(names(fitMeasures(m3gls)),
                                as.numeric(fitMeasures(m3gls))), 
               paste("real_data_maps/lavaan_out/simpi_DAG3_fitmeasures_1Mb_chr", 
                     c, "_", d, "_", m, "_", u, ".csv", sep=""),
               col.names=F)
        
        fwrite(lavTestLRT(m2gls, m3gls),
               paste("real_data_maps/lavaan_out/LRT_DAG2_DAG3_1Mb_chr",
                     c, "_", d, "_", m, "_", u, ".csv", sep=""))
      }
    }
  }
}
```

```{r SEM-human-fitmeasures, eval=F, include=F, message=F, warning=F}
## 10 kb

          tmp$mut_map <- u
          tmp$constrained_model <- m
          tmp$demo <- d
          
          chr_list[[c]] <- tmp
        }
        
        df <- do.call(rbind.data.frame, chr_list)
        chr_fitmeasures_10kb <- rbind.data.frame(chr_fitmeasures_10kb, df)
      }
    }
  }
}

# (Nested) model selection, DAGs 2 and 3 (LRT)
# (DAG 3 adds a covariance term between constrained sites and mutation rates)
LRT_gw_10kb <- data.frame()
for(u in unique(human_maps_10kb$mut_map)) {
  for(m in unique(human_maps_10kb$constrained_model)) { 
    for(d in unique(human_maps_10kb$demo)) {
      
      tmp <- fread(paste("real_data_maps/lavaan_out/LRT_DAG2_DAG3_10kb_genomewide_",
                   d, "_", m, "_", u, ".csv", sep=""))
      
      df <- as.data.frame(tmp$`Pr(>Chisq)`[2],)  
      df$mut_map <- u
      df$constrained_model <- m
      df$demo <- d
      
      LRT_gw_10kb <- rbind.data.frame(LRT_gw_10kb, df)
    }
  }
}
LRT_gw_10kb$scale <- 1e+4

LRT_gw_100kb <- data.frame()
for(u in unique(human_maps_100kb$mut_map)) {
  for(m in unique(human_maps_100kb$constrained_model)) { 
    for(d in unique(human_maps_100kb$demo)) {
      
      tmp <- fread(paste("real_data_maps/lavaan_out/LRT_DAG2_DAG3_100kb_genomewide_",
                   d, "_", m, "_", u, ".csv", sep=""))

      df$constrained_model <- m
      df$demo <- d
      
      LRT_gw_100kb <- rbind.data.frame(LRT_gw_100kb, df)
    }
  }
}

  for(m in unique(human_maps_1Mb$constrained_model)) {
```

```{r SEM-human-params, eval=F, include=F, message=F, warning=F}
# per chromosome SEM models
## 10 kb
chr_params_10kb <- data.frame()
for(dag in 2:3) {
  for(u in unique(human_maps_10kb$mut_map)) {
    for(m in unique(human_maps_10kb$constrained_model)) { 
      for(d in unique(human_maps_10kb$demo)) {
        chr_list <- list(length=22)
        for(c in 1:22) {
          tmp <- fread(paste("real_data_maps/lavaan_out/simpi_DAG", dag, 
                             "_params_10kb_chr", c, "_", 
                             d, "_", m, "_", u, ".csv", sep=""))
          
          tmp$chrom <- c
          tmp$DAG <- dag
          tmp$mut_map <- u
          tmp$constrained_model <- m
          tmp$demo <- d
          
          chr_list[[c]] <- tmp
        }
        
        df <- do.call(rbind.data.frame, chr_list)
        chr_params_10kb <- rbind.data.frame(chr_params_10kb, df)
      }
    }
  }
}
chr_params_10kb$scale <- 1e+4

## 100 kb

          tmp$chrom <- c
          tmp$DAG <- dag

        }
        
        df <- do.call(rbind.data.frame, chr_list)

    }
  }
}

## 1 Mb
chr_params_1Mb <- data.frame()
for(dag in 2:3) {
  for(u in unique(human_maps_1Mb$mut_map)) {
    for(m in unique(human_maps_1Mb$constrained_model)) {

        chr_list <- list(length=22)

          tmp$chrom <- c

        }

        chr_params_1Mb <- rbind.data.frame(chr_params_1Mb, df)

}
chr_params_1Mb$scale <- 1e+6

chr_params <- rbind.data.frame(chr_params_10kb,
                               chr_params_100kb,
                               chr_params_1Mb)  %>%
              filter(., pvalue < 0.05) %>%
              filter(., op=="~" | op==":=") 

chr_params_ext <- left_join(chr_params, 
                            chr_fitmeasures,
                            by=c("chrom", "DAG", "mut_map",
                                 "constrained_model", "demo", "scale"))

names(chr_params_ext)[8] <- "pvalue_est"
names(chr_params_ext)[21] <- "pvalue_DAG"

           x="Chromosome", y="Direct Std. PC to Diversity") +

# ratios of PCs from B and Mu to Pi
chr_wide <- chr_params_ext %>% filter(., pvalue_est < 5e-2) %>%
         dplyr::select(., -c(op, label, se, z, pvalue_est, pvalue_DAG,
                             ci.lower, ci.upper)) %>%
         filter(., demo=="equilibrium", lhs=="pi_sim_tot") %>% 
         filter(., rhs=="avg_mut" | rhs=="B") %>%
         pivot_wider(values_from="est", names_from="rhs")
         #filter(., avg_mut >)
          
chr_wide$ratio_B_u <- chr_wide$B / chr_wide$avg_mut # chr 19 is weird!

r <- ggplot(data=chr_wide, 
             aes(x=chrom, 
                 y=ratio_B_u, 
                 color=mut_map,
                 alpha=gfi,
                 shape=as.factor(DAG))) +
      geom_point(size=2.5) + 
      geom_hline(yintercept=1, linetype="dashed") +
      facet_grid(scale~constrained_model, labeller=label_both) + theme_bw() + 
      scale_y_continuous(breaks=pretty_breaks()) +
      scale_x_continuous(breaks=1:22) + 
      scale_shape_manual(values=c(0, 1),
                         name="DAG") +
      scale_color_manual(values=c("purple3", "seagreen4", "brown1"), 
                         name="Mut. Map") +
      labs(title="Ratio of Path Coefficients to Pi (GFI > 0.95, pval_est < 0.05)",
           x="Chromosome", y="PC(B) / PC(Mu)") +
      theme(strip.text.y=element_text(size=16),
            strip.text.x=element_text(size=16),  
            axis.title=element_text(size=16), 
            axis.text=element_text(size=12), 
            axis.text.x=element_text(size=12),
            legend.text=element_text(size=16),
            legend.title=element_text(size=16),
            legend.position="bottom")

          r, base_height=8, base_width=20)
```
